name: CDC Beard Campus (BE1)
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; third Canberra campus location.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework (CDC group)
description_en: A 39MW first building on CDC's new Beard campus in Canberra's east, under construction to add a third sovereign availability zone in the ACT.
description_zh: CDC在堪培拉东侧Beard新园区的首栋楼，IT负载39 MW，目前在建，建成后将成为CDC在首都领地的第三个主权可用区。

name: CDC Fyshwick Campus (FY1-FY2)
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; geographically diverse from Hume campuses.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, ISO 27001
description_en: CDC's 45MW Fyshwick campus, the second Canberra node providing metro diversity for Commonwealth and cloud workloads.
description_zh: CDC在堪培拉的第二个节点，位于Fyshwick，IT负载45 MW，2016年投运，为联邦政府和云服务商提供与Hume园区异地的同城容灾。

name: CDC Hume Campus One (HU1-HU3)
key_tenants: Australian Government, Defence, Microsoft Azure Australia Central
power_source_notes: Evoenergy 132kV/11kV; dual-campus separation from Hume Two and Fyshwick for government resilience.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, ISO 27001, DISP
description_en: CDC's original Canberra campus (from 2008), the core of Australia's sovereign government hosting market and home to Microsoft's Azure Australia Central regions.
description_zh: CDC最早的堪培拉园区，2008年投运，IT负载21 MW，是澳洲主权政府托管市场的核心资产，微软Azure Australia Central区域即部署于此。

name: CDC Hume Campus Two (HU4-HU5)
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply, separate feeders from Campus One.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, ISO 27001
description_en: CDC's second Hume campus, 51MW across two buildings, extending its government-certified Canberra footprint.
description_zh: CDC在Hume的第二个园区，2018年投运，两栋楼合计51 MW，客户为联邦政府、国防部及超大规模云，与Campus One采用独立馈线供电。

name: Equinix CA1 Canberra
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; former Metronode Canberra facility acquired by Equinix in 2018.
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic
description_en: Equinix's Canberra IBX (ex-Metronode) in Mitchell, a government-certified colocation site providing carrier-neutral interconnection in the capital.
description_zh: Equinix在堪培拉Mitchell的IBX，原为Metronode设施，2018年随收购并入；具备政府认证，是首都地区运营商中立的托管与互联节点。

name: Macquarie Data Centres Canberra Campus (IC4 / IC5 Bunker)
address: Canberra Data Centre Campus, ACT (address undisclosed for security)
key_tenants: Australian Federal Government (42% of agencies per Macquarie), hyperscalers
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; MW undisclosed; coordinates approximate (campus location not published).
certifications: Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SCEC, Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic
description_en: Macquarie's secure 'Bunker' campus in Canberra (IC4/IC5), a Certified Strategic sovereign facility hosting a large share of Commonwealth agency workloads.
description_zh: Macquarie在堪培拉的"Bunker"高安全园区（IC4/IC5），2020年投运，属Certified Strategic级主权设施，承载相当比例的联邦机构工作负载；容量未公开。

name: NEXTDC C1 Canberra
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; N+1; purpose-built to PSPF/SCEC requirements.
certifications: ISO 27001, SOC 1/2 Type II, PCI DSS, DTA Certified Strategic, Climate Active
description_en: A 4.4MW government-grade colocation site in Bruce, small but strategically relevant as a Certified Strategic hosting facility for Commonwealth workloads.
description_zh: NEXTDC在堪培拉Bruce的政府级托管设施，2012年投运，IT负载4.4 MW；规模虽小，但具备Certified Strategic认证，对联邦工作负载有战略价值。

name: STACK Infrastructure CAN01 Hume
power_source_notes: Evoenergy supply; 28MW planned; part of STACK's AU$1.3bn Australian buildout financing; status 'planned/in development' per market listings.
description_en: STACK's 28MW Canberra campus in the Hume data centre precinct, designed for government-grade and hyperscale tenants; delivery timing not publicly confirmed.
description_zh: STACK在堪培拉Hume数据中心片区规划的28 MW园区，目标客户为政府级和超大规模租户，目前在建，交付时间尚未公开确认。

name: AIMS Capital Bella Vista Data Centre Campus
power_source_notes: Details not public; project listed among 15 IDA-endorsed NSW data centres (Mar 2026).
description_en: A Hills Shire data centre campus sponsored by AIMS Capital Management and fast-tracked through the NSW Investment Delivery Authority in March 2026; capacity not yet disclosed.
description_zh: AIMS Capital Management在悉尼Hills区Bella Vista发起的数据中心园区，2026年3月被新州投资交付局（IDA）纳入加速审批名单；容量尚未披露。

name: AWS Eastern Creek Campus (William Dean Street)
address: William Dean Street, Eastern Creek NSW 2766
power_source_notes: Sydney West bulk supply area; multiple self-built buildings (1 William Dean A/B etc.); part of AWS's $13.2bn 2023-27 Australian investment; MW not disclosed.
description_en: Amazon's owned Western Sydney data centre cluster at Eastern Creek supporting the ap-southeast-2 region, built out in several phases since 2022.
description_zh: 亚马逊在西悉尼Eastern Creek的自建数据中心集群，2022年起分期建设，支撑AWS ap-southeast-2区域；容量未公开。

name: AWS South-West Sydney Campus (Smeaton Grange / Gregory Hills)
address: 42A Bluett Drive & 52 Turner Road, Smeaton Grange NSW 2567; 43-61 Turner Road, Gregory Hills NSW 2557
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy Macarthur network; existing SYD52 at Bluett Drive operational; 40MW building proposed at 52 Turner Rd; 9.4ha Gregory Hills site (27 generators) in early works with DC application to DPHI.
description_en: Amazon's second Sydney self-build cluster in the Macarthur region, with an operating site at Bluett Drive and further buildings at Turner Road progressing through NSW planning.
description_zh: 亚马逊在悉尼西南Macarthur地区的第二个自建集群：Bluett Drive的SYD52已投运，Turner Road的后续楼栋正在走新州规划审批。

name: AirTrunk Kurri Kurri (Hunter) Data Centre
address: Hart Road, Loxford NSW 2326 (former Hydro Kurri Kurri smelter site)
power_source_notes: 132kV grid connection with AirTrunk funding the full connection cost and a new substation; renewable supply to be procured from new New England REZ generation. No community water used for cooling - water limited to amenities.
description_en: AirTrunk lodged the Environmental Impact Statement for its 540MW Kurri Kurri data centre in September 2026, on the former Hydro Aluminium smelter site at Hart Road, Loxford, with capex now stated at about A$3.7 billion and a building footprint of roughly 44,220sqm over two storeys. A A$37 million community benefit package was announced on 16-17 September 2026, including a Community Energy Program offering A$200 a year off eligible households' electricity bills, and 350-plus ongoing jobs are forecast. The NSW Planning Portal still shows the application at 'Prepare EIS'; a public exhibition date has not been set.
description_zh: AirTrunk 于 2026 年 9 月就 540 MW 的 Kurri Kurri 项目递交 EIS，场地为 Hart Road, Loxford 的原 Hydro Aluminium 冶炼厂用地，投资口径更新至约 37亿澳元，两层建筑约 44,220 ㎡、高约 16.8 m。供电按 132 kV 接入，接入成本与新建变电站由 AirTrunk 自行承担，并承诺采购 New England REZ 的新增可再生电源；冷却采用风冷，不取用社区供水，用水仅限生活设施。9 月 16–17 日同步公布 3,700万澳元社区回馈方案，含每户每年 200 澳元电费补贴的 Community Energy Program，其中 1,200万澳元用于体育设施与社区储能，预计长期岗位 350 个以上。NSW 规划门户仍显示处于 Prepare EIS 阶段，公展日期未定。

name: AirTrunk Lane Cove West Expansion (Apollo Place / Mars Road)
address: 3-4 Apollo Place & 87-91 Mars Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066
power_source_notes: Ausgrid North Shore network; requires EIS before community consultation (early planning stage as of Apr 2026).
description_en: A proposed five-storey, 140MW extension of AirTrunk's Sydney North footprint across two sites in the Lane Cove West business park, disclosed in council planning updates in 2026.
description_zh: AirTrunk拟在Lane Cove West商务园两个地块上扩建140 MW、五层的悉尼北项目，2026年经市议会规划通报披露，仍处早期规划阶段。

name: AirTrunk SYD1 Sydney West
power_source_notes: Diverse 132kV high-voltage feeds from Endeavour Energy network (Sydney West bulk supply area); design PUE 1.15. Capacity figure ~130MW per RenewMap/AirTrunk; combined SYD1+SYD3 campus 450MW+.
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, ISAE 3402, SCEC Zone 3+
description_en: AirTrunk's first Australian hyperscale campus, opened in 2017 in Huntingwood in Western Sydney and progressively expanded to around 130MW across 42 data halls, anchored by hyperscale cloud tenants.
description_zh: AirTrunk在澳洲的首个超大规模园区，2017年在西悉尼Huntingwood投运，经多轮扩建至约130 MW、42个数据大厅，锁定租户为超大规模云服务商。

name: AirTrunk SYD2 Sydney North
address: Sirius Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066
power_source_notes: Ausgrid 132kV supply; 70MW expansion (2023-24) lifted capacity to 120MW+; RenewMap lists 158MW. Local council notes further ~45MW approved-but-unbuilt stage at Apollo Place.
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, ISAE 3402
description_en: AirTrunk's North Shore hyperscale facility in the Lane Cove West business park, opened 2021 and expanded by 70MW in 2023-24 to more than 120MW, giving hyperscalers a second Sydney availability zone away from the western cluster.
description_zh: AirTrunk在悉尼北岸Lane Cove West商务园的超大规模设施，2021年投运，2023–24年扩容70 MW至120 MW以上，为云巨头提供独立于西悉尼集群的第二可用区。

name: AirTrunk SYD3 Sydney West
address: Huntingwood Drive precinct (adjacent SYD1), Huntingwood NSW 2148
power_source_notes: Adjacent to Sydney West 330/132kV bulk supply point; initially filed at 320MW (2024), now tracked at 400MW (ITK/RenewMap). Bouygues awarded ~$1.3bn build contract. Design PUE 1.15, ~80% lower water use than conventional.
certifications: ISO 27001 (AirTrunk group)
description_en: Seven-storey, ~123,000 sqm hyperscale build next to SYD1 that AirTrunk bills as the largest independent hyperscale data centre in APJ; first phases energised 2025 with the campus scaling toward 400MW.
description_zh: 紧邻SYD1的七层、约12.3万平方米超大规模项目，AirTrunk称之为亚太及日本地区最大的独立超大规模数据中心；首期2025年通电，园区规划容量400 MW。

name: AirTrunk SYD4 'Summit at Kemps Creek'
power_source_notes: Up to four on-site substations planned within Mamre Road precinct (Endeavour Energy / Transgrid West Sydney network); 846-852 diesel backup generators; 100% renewables commitment by 2030. SEARS filed Sep 2025 by ISPT vehicle (KNBDC/Plan Project Management); EIS on exhibition 2026 with EPA raising information gaps and strong local objections; IDA-endorsed Mar 2026.
description_en: A 52-hectare, six-building campus on Mamre Road filed by ISPT and being acquired by AirTrunk as 'SYD4'; at 1-1.2GW it would be Australia's first gigawatt-scale data centre campus but is still working through NSW state assessment.
description_zh: 位于Kemps Creek Mamre Road的52公顷、六栋楼园区，由ISPT申报，AirTrunk有条件收购并命名为SYD4；规划1–1.2 GW，有望成为澳洲首个吉瓦级数据中心园区，目前仍在新州州级审批中。

name: CDC Eastern Creek Campus (EC1-EC6)
owner: Infratil / Commonwealth Superannuation Corp / Future Fund (CDC)
power_source_notes: Transmission-grade 132kV connection (Sydney West bulk supply); EC1 6MW, EC2 13MW, EC4 ~78MW operational; EC5 & EC6 (~108MW IT each per ITK) under construction, campus total ~230MW.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, ISO 27001, DISP
description_en: CDC's Sydney flagship on the former HP site at Eastern Creek: four operating buildings with EC5/EC6 under construction, taking the government-certified campus toward ~230MW.
description_zh: CDC在悉尼的旗舰园区，位于Eastern Creek原HP用地，四栋楼在运、EC5/EC6在建，园区满建约230 MW，具备政府认证。

name: CDC Marsden Park Campus
address: Marsden Park Industrial Precinct (Hollinsworth Road area), Marsden Park NSW 2765
key_tenants: Undisclosed hyperscalers; reported front-runner for Anthropic 300-500MW Australian training contract
power_source_notes: Dedicated 720MVA substation (Endeavour Energy/Transgrid); 40 generators; six four-storey buildings, scalable toward 1GW. State approval Nov 2025 (largest DC approval in southern hemisphere); early construction underway. Capex figure is initial-stage estimate.
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic (CDC group)
description_en: CDC's 504MW, six-building AI/cloud campus in Marsden Park, approved by NSW in late 2025 and in early construction, with scope to reach 1GW.
description_zh: CDC在Marsden Park的504 MW、六栋楼AI及云园区，2025年底获新州批准，已进入早期施工，远期可扩至1 GW。

name: DCI CBR01 Canberra (Jerrabomberra)
power_source_notes: New Essential Energy 132kV line under multi-party agreement; Tier III / SCEC Zone 3 design; originally targeted RFS 2024, still listed as 'developing' by DCI in 2026.
certifications: Uptime Tier III (design), SCEC Zone 3 (design)
description_en: A 20MW, eight-hall secure 'cloud edge' facility on the NSW side of the Canberra border, built to give Commonwealth cloud workloads supply-chain and geographic diversity from the Hume/Fyshwick cluster.
description_zh: DCI在堪培拉边界新州一侧Jerrabomberra在建的20 MW、八个数据大厅高安全"云边缘"设施，为联邦云工作负载提供与Hume/Fyshwick集群不同的供应链和地理冗余。

name: DCI Data Centers Sydney (SYD01 / SYD02 / SYD03)
address: 90 Peter Brock Drive, Eastern Creek NSW 2766
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy supply; SYD01 11MW live; SYD02 (36MW, AU$400m) and SYD03 in development on the same site, targeting ~65MW campus total.
certifications: Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001
description_en: Brookfield-backed DCI's Eastern Creek campus: an 11MW first building live since 2020 with SYD02/SYD03 under development toward roughly 65MW for hyperscale and MSP customers.
description_zh: Brookfield旗下DCI的Eastern Creek园区，首栋SYD01（11 MW）2020年投运，SYD02/SYD03在开发中，园区目标约65 MW，客户为超大规模云和托管服务商。

name: DigiCo SYD1 Ultimo (ex-Global Switch Sydney)
owner: DigiCo Infrastructure REIT (ASX: DGT, HMC Capital)
address: 390-422 Harris Street & 273 Pyrmont Street, Ultimo NSW 2007
key_tenants: Carriers, financial services, cloud on-ramps, enterprise
power_source_notes: Ausgrid CBD-fringe 132kV/33kV; $605m 'roof raise' to double IT load to 88MW (SSD on exhibition 2025).
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS
description_en: The former Global Switch Sydney East/West campus in Ultimo, acquired by DigiCo for $1.9bn, with a $605m plan to lift IT capacity from 42.5MW to 88MW by adding floors to both buildings.
description_zh: 位于Ultimo的原Global Switch悉尼东/西园区，2001年投运，DigiCo以19亿澳元收购；计划投资6.05亿澳元对两栋楼加层，将IT容量从42.5 MW提升至88 MW。

name: Digital Realty Erskine Park Campus (SYD10/SYD11/SYD14)
address: 1-12 & 13-23 Templar Road and 16 Lockwood Road, Erskine Park NSW 2759
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy 132kV; 2020 acquisition of two Erskine Park/Horsley Park parcels (16.2ha) for a campus of up to 250MW; SYD11 ~19MW.
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2
description_en: Digital Realty's long-standing Western Sydney campus on Templar Road, being expanded via adjacent Erskine Park and Horsley Park land toward a 250MW multi-building footprint.
description_zh: Digital Realty在Templar Road经营多年的西悉尼园区，2011年投运，正借助毗邻的Erskine Park和Horsley Park地块扩建为满建250 MW的多楼园区。

name: Equinix SY1-SY4 Mascot / Alexandria Cluster
address: 639 Gardeners Road, Mascot NSW 2020 and 47 Bourke Road, Alexandria NSW 2015
key_tenants: Southern Cross Cable, carriers, IX peering, cloud on-ramps
power_source_notes: Ausgrid supply; legacy campus with >20 years of incremental expansion (MW not disclosed).
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2
description_en: Equinix's original Sydney campus and cable-landing/interconnection hub for the Southern Cross and other trans-Pacific systems; small by modern MW standards but strategically central.
description_zh: Equinix在悉尼的原始园区，2000年起运营，是Southern Cross等跨太平洋海缆的登陆与互联枢纽；容量按当前标准不大，但战略地位关键。

name: Equinix SY5 Alexandria
address: Unit B, 200 Bourke Road, Alexandria NSW 2015
key_tenants: Cloud on-ramps, carriers, enterprise, subsea cable operators
power_source_notes: Ausgrid 132kV; multiple expansion phases (latest AU$66m); 100% renewable via Equinix procurement.
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2, Uptime-aligned
description_en: Equinix's largest Sydney IBX, a ~54MW retail colocation campus in Alexandria that anchors Sydney's densest interconnection ecosystem.
description_zh: Equinix在悉尼最大的IBX，位于Alexandria，约54 MW，2019年投运，是悉尼互联生态最密集的零售托管园区。

name: Equinix xScale SY9x / SY10x Rosehill
address: Grand Avenue / James Ruse Drive precinct, Rosehill NSW 2142
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy supply in Rosehill; 55MW+ combined across two buildings; SY9x opened 2022, SY10x follow-on.
certifications: ISO 27001 (Equinix)
description_en: Equinix and PGIM's first Australian xScale hyperscale JV, two buildings at Rosehill totalling 55MW+ for large cloud deployments adjacent to the retail IBX ecosystem.
description_zh: Equinix与PGIM在澳洲的首个xScale超大规模合资项目，位于Rosehill，两栋楼合计55 MW以上，SY9x于2022年投运，面向云巨头的大规模部署，并紧邻Equinix零售IBX生态。

name: Fujitsu Western Sydney Data Centre
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy supply; MW undisclosed (third-party listings cite up to 92MW power capacity, treated as unverified).
certifications: ISO 27001, Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic
description_en: Fujitsu's flagship Australian Tier III facility at Greystanes, a government-certified enterprise data centre that complements its Homebush and North Ryde sites.
description_zh: Fujitsu在澳洲的旗舰Tier III设施，位于Greystanes，2013年投运，具备政府认证，与其Homebush和North Ryde站点互补；容量未公开。

name: Glendenning Road Data Centre (LCI)
key_tenants: Undisclosed hyperscaler (LCI has acted for Microsoft on other Sydney sites)
power_source_notes: Approximately 235MW maximum electrical demand against 193.6MW IT load; three internal substations and 97 standby diesel generators approved.
description_en: SSD-73761707 was determined on 14 September 2026, approving three five-storey data centre buildings totalling 50,233sqm on 10.43ha at 2 Glendenning Road, Glendenning: 193.6MW IT load (DC01 79.2MW, DC02 35.2MW, DC03 79.2MW), ~235MW maximum demand and A$2.17 billion capex, delivered in three stages. Lehr Consultants International is the formal proponent; multiple outlets report AWS as the end user, but this is not confirmed in the application. Blacktown City Council objected during exhibition.
description_zh: SSD-73761707 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日获批：2 Glendenning Road, Glendenning 的 10.43 公顷地块建三栋五层厂房，合计 50,233 ㎡、最高约 43.2 m，IT负载 193.6 MW（DC01 79.2 MW、DC02 35.2 MW、DC03 79.2 MW），最大需量约 235 MW，造价 21.7亿澳元，分三期交付，配 3 座内部变电站与 97 台柴发。申请主体为 Lehr Consultants International，多家媒体指向 AWS 为最终用户，官方文件未予确认。Blacktown City Council 在公展期提出反对。项目预计带来约 1,076 个建设岗位、106 个运营岗位。

name: Goodman Project Apollo Macquarie Park
power_source_notes: Ausgrid Macquarie Park network; grid with diesel backup and Li-ion batteries; evaporative cooling towers. SSD approved 2 Sep 2026 after 541-day assessment.
description_en: A 135MW, eight-hall, five-storey data centre approved in September 2026 on Talavera Road, making Macquarie Park one of Sydney's densest data centre precincts.
description_zh: Goodman在Macquarie Park Talavera Road的135 MW数据中心，五层、八个数据大厅，2026年9月获SSD批准，Macquarie Park由此成为悉尼数据中心密度最高的片区之一。

name: Goodman Project Atlas Eastern Creek
power_source_notes: On-site substation off Sydney West 330/132kV BSP; DCCEEW requiring Goodman to demonstrate new renewable supply. SEARS Jan 2026 (former Coles DC site next to CDC); IDA-endorsed Mar 2026; targeting 2029.
description_en: Goodman's largest Australian data centre proposal: a ~$5.5bn, 500MW two-building 'AI factory' campus on the former Coles distribution centre at Eastern Creek, awaiting state determination.
description_zh: Goodman在澳洲最大的数据中心提案：在Eastern Creek原Coles配送中心地块上开发约55亿澳元、500 MW的双楼"AI工厂"园区，目前待州政府审批。

name: Goodman Project Mars Lane Cove West
address: 12 Mars Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066
power_source_notes: Ausgrid North Shore network; SSD on public exhibition to 28 Apr 2026 with significant local objection.
description_en: Goodman formally withdrew the State Significant Development application for the 90MW, ~A$1.2 billion data centre at 12 Mars Road, Lane Cove West in the week of 28 September 2026. The exhibition drew 374 submissions with only nine supportive; the nearest homes are 20m away and a primary school 160m away. Goodman said the policy and regulatory environment for large-scale data centre development had evolved significantly since it began the process in March 2025.
description_zh: Goodman 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日当周正式撤回 12 Mars Road, Lane Cove West 的 SSD 申请，项目规模 90 MW、投资约 12亿澳元。公展期共收到 374 份意见，仅 9 份支持；场地距最近住宅 20 m、距小学 160 m。公司表示，自 2025 年 3 月启动规划以来，联邦与州层面针对大型数据中心的政策与监管环境已明显收紧，并称已考虑社区意见。Goodman 在悉尼的其余管线继续推进——Macquarie Park 135 MW、Guildford West 126 MW、前 ABC 影棚 90 MW、Mascot 旧 Eaton 仓库 90 MW。

name: Goodman Project Pluto Guildford West
power_source_notes: Stage 1 (34MW) direct from Transgrid Guildford transmission substation; Stage 2 (34MW) via new on-site substation on Endeavour network. Approved Jul 2026; earlier iterations cited 126MW/$2.5bn.
description_en: Goodman's former-Castrol-site data centre at Guildford West, approved in July 2026 as a two-stage 68MW, nine-hall facility with power staged to grid availability.
description_zh: Goodman在Guildford West原Castrol地块的数据中心，2026年7月获批，分两期建设68 MW、九个数据大厅，供电按电网容量释放进度分期到位。

name: Goodman SYD01 Artarmon
power_source_notes: 90MW utility feed from Ausgrid; 61MW IT; Phase 1 12.2MW targeted Q2 2028; builder AW Edwards; ground broken Mar 2026.
description_en: Goodman's first Australian self-developed data centre, on the former ABC TV studios in Artarmon, under construction with 61MW IT capacity and first phase due 2028.
description_zh: Goodman在澳洲首个自主开发的数据中心，位于Artarmon原ABC电视台旧址，IT负载61 MW，2026年3月开工，首期预计2028年投运。

name: GreenSquareDC SYD1 Greater Western Sydney Campus
address: Norwest / Bella Vista precinct, Hills Shire NSW 2153
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy Hills network; Stage 2 (96MW) endorsed by Hills Shire Council Jan 2026 and IDA-endorsed Mar 2026; campus marketed as 100MW+; stage 1 build status not clearly disclosed.
description_en: GreenSquareDC announced on 21 September 2026 a long-term contract with Nasdaq-listed Nvidia Cloud Partner Sharon AI for the first stage of SYD1 at 3 Brookhollow Avenue, Baulkham Hills — the campus's first anchor tenant. Sharon AI plans roughly 8,200 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs with initial operations targeted for Q4 2026. The campus combines a refurbished legacy building with new build; Stage 2 (80MW) was endorsed by the NSW Investment Delivery Authority in March 2026.
description_zh: GreenSquareDC 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日宣布与纳斯达克上市的 Nvidia Cloud Partner Sharon AI 签订长期合同，锁定 SYD1 一期算力，为该园区首个锁定租户。SYD1 位于 3 Brookhollow Avenue（原 IBM 场地），由既有机房改造与新建楼栋组成；Sharon AI 计划部署约 8,200 颗 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPU，首批上线目标为 2026 年四季度。二期 80 MW 已于 2026 年 3 月获 NSW Investment Delivery Authority 支持。园区满建规模媒体报道为 110 MW，与此前 100 MW 口径存在差异，尚待核实。

name: ISPT Julius Avenue Data Centre North Ryde
power_source_notes: On-site switching station, 72 x 3.2MW generators; Ausgrid North Ryde network. SSD exhibited 2025.
description_en: A $1.8bn, six-storey 170MW data centre proposed by ISPT on a long-held Riverside Corporate Park site, pivoting from office to data centre use.
description_zh: ISPT在其长期持有的North Ryde Riverside Corporate Park地块上由办公开发改为数据中心，规划六层、170 MW，投资18亿澳元，目前处于规划阶段。

name: Leading Edge DC WGA1 Wagga Wagga
power_source_notes: Essential Energy distribution; prefabricated 30-75 rack modules.
description_en: A small prefabricated edge data centre in Wagga Wagga, part of Leading Edge DC's regional NSW network (Newcastle, Tamworth, Dubbo, Coffs Harbour) - strategically notable rather than MW-significant.
description_zh: Leading Edge DC在Wagga Wagga的小型预制边缘数据中心，2022年投运，属其覆盖新州区域城市（Newcastle、Tamworth、Dubbo、Coffs Harbour）的网络之一，战略意义大于容量规模。

name: Macquarie Data Centres Macquarie Park Campus (IC2 / IC3 East / IC3 Super West)
key_tenants: Australian Government agencies, hyperscale cloud, enterprise AI
power_source_notes: Ausgrid supply; IC3 Super West raised from 32MW to 45MW (campus 50MW to 63MW); construction complete 2025, fit-out and phased commissioning 2025-26; AU$130m raised 2023.
certifications: Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SCEC, Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic
description_en: Macquarie's sovereign colocation campus in Macquarie Park; the new IC3 Super West adds 45MW of AI-ready capacity, lifting the campus to 63MW.
description_zh: Macquarie在Macquarie Park的主权托管园区，2012年起运营；新建的IC3 Super West新增45 MW面向AI的容量，园区总规模提升至63 MW。

name: Markham 22 O'Riordan Street Alexandria Data Centre
power_source_notes: Ausgrid inner-south network near Equinix SY cluster; SEARS Nov 2024; DCD-reported capex (AU$2bn) appears inconsistent with 38MW and is omitted.
description_en: A 38MW mixed-use data centre proposed by Markham on a former Mercedes-Benz body-shop site in Alexandria, adjacent to Sydney's key interconnection precinct.
description_zh: Markham拟在Alexandria原Mercedes-Benz车身维修厂地块上建设38 MW混合用途数据中心，毗邻悉尼核心互联片区，目前处于规划阶段。

name: Mayfield Energy Precinct Data Centre (Port of Newcastle)
owner: Port of Newcastle / Newcastle Logistics Precinct proponents
address: Former Intertrade / BHP steelworks site, Mayfield NSW 2304
power_source_notes: Adjacent to Ausgrid/Transgrid Newcastle transmission and Port of Newcastle clean-energy precinct; listed as 1,000MW 'development' stage by RenewMap; limited public detail.
description_en: A gigawatt-scale data centre concept within the Mayfield clean-energy and logistics precinct at the Port of Newcastle, tracked by RenewMap but with sparse public disclosure.
description_zh: Newcastle港Mayfield清洁能源与物流片区内的吉瓦级数据中心概念项目，RenewMap将其列为1,000 MW开发阶段项目，公开信息有限。

name: Microsoft Honeman Close Huntingwood Data Centre
power_source_notes: Dedicated 132kV substation with three transformers, 47 diesel generators; six-storey building. SSD lodged May 2024 (via LCI), IDA-endorsed Mar 2026; capex figure is SSD estimated development cost (likely shell only).
certifications: Design targets: PUE 1.28, WUE 1.55 L/kWh
description_en: NSW DPHI determined SSD-58601963 on 1 October 2026, approving a 96MW IT load data centre across 40 data halls on five floors at 6 Honeman Close, Huntingwood, on a 5.03ha site, at A$1.26 billion capex. Conditions include a 1.28 PUE target, a 1.55 L/kWh WUE target, retention of 0.78ha of conservation area and ongoing noise, air-quality, energy and water monitoring.
description_zh: NSW DPHI 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日核准 SSD-58601963：微软在 6 Honeman Close, Huntingwood 的 5.03 公顷地块建设 IT负载 96 MW 的数据中心，五层共 40 个机房，造价 12.6亿澳元。批复设定 PUE 1.28、WUE 1.55 L/kWh，要求保留并管理 0.78 公顷保育用地，并持续监测噪声、空气质量及能耗水耗。申请主体仍为 Lehr Consultants International。该项目过关与 Goodman 撤回 Lane Cove West 的 Project Mars 几乎同期，是新州新政策框架下首批获批的大型项目之一。

name: Microsoft Kemps Creek Campus (SYD05/06/07)
power_source_notes: Mamre Road precinct, Endeavour Energy network; ~96MW first stage expandable to 190MW; two two-storey buildings (65,355 sqm); builder AW Edwards; VPA with Penrith Council.
description_en: Microsoft's $1.3bn self-build Azure campus at Kemps Creek, its largest owned facility in Australia, staged from ~96MW to 190MW.
description_zh: 微软在Kemps Creek自建的Azure园区，投资13亿澳元，是其在澳洲最大的自有设施，首期约96 MW，可分期扩至190 MW，目前在建。

name: Microsoft Seven Hills (Station Road) Campus
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy supply; Building 1 complete 2023 (FDC), Building 2 (Taylor) late 2024; further 'Station Road Data Centre Expansion' SSD lodged.
description_en: Microsoft's first self-built Sydney data centre campus, two buildings delivered 2023-24 with a further expansion in state assessment.
description_zh: 微软在悉尼首个自建数据中心园区，两栋楼于2023–24年交付，后续扩建已进入州级评估。

name: Minchinbury AI Data Centre (Starwood / Doma / Telstra InfraCo)
owner: Starwood Capital / Doma Infrastructure (land: Telstra InfraCo)
power_source_notes: Endeavour Energy; DA approved; construction from early 2026, RFS early Q1 2028; Tier III design.
certifications: Uptime Tier III (design)
description_en: A 62MW AI-optimised, carrier-neutral data centre on Telstra land at Minchinbury, financed by Starwood and Doma with Telstra contributing land and connectivity.
description_zh: 在Telstra位于Minchinbury的地块上建设的62 MW AI优化、运营商中立数据中心，由Starwood和Doma出资，Telstra提供土地和网络接入，目前在建。

name: NEXTDC S1 Sydney
address: 4 Eden Park Drive, Macquarie Park NSW 2113
key_tenants: Enterprise, cloud on-ramps (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Oracle), carriers
power_source_notes: Ausgrid 33kV/132kV supply; 100% renewable via NEXTDC procurement.
certifications: Uptime Tier III Design & Facility, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DTA Certified Strategic
description_en: NEXTDC's first Sydney colocation facility and a key North Sydney interconnection hub with all major cloud on-ramps.
description_zh: NEXTDC在悉尼的首座托管数据中心，位于Macquarie Park，2013年投运，IT负载16 MW，汇聚各大公有云接入点，是悉尼北部的重要互联枢纽。

name: NEXTDC S2 Sydney
address: 6 Eden Park Drive, Macquarie Park NSW 2113
power_source_notes: Ausgrid supply; Uptime Tier IV certified.
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Gold (Operational Sustainability), ISO 27001, DTA Certified Strategic
description_en: A 30MW Tier IV colocation facility adjoining S1, one of only a handful of Uptime Tier IV Gold sites in Australia.
description_zh: 紧邻S1的30 MW Tier IV托管设施，2017年投运，是澳洲少数获Uptime Tier IV Gold认证的站点之一。

name: NEXTDC S3 Sydney
address: Artarmon NSW 2064 (Reserve Road / Herbert Street industrial precinct)
power_source_notes: Ausgrid 132kV; RenewMap lists 80MW; NEXTDC does not disclose built MW per site.
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Design & Facility, ISO 27001, DTA Certified Strategic
description_en: NEXTDC's flagship 80MW Sydney campus at Artarmon, opened 2021, designed to Tier IV and serving hyperscale and enterprise customers on the North Shore.
description_zh: NEXTDC的悉尼旗舰园区，位于Artarmon，2021年投运，规划80 MW、按Tier IV设计，服务北岸的超大规模云和企业客户。

name: NEXTDC S4 Sydney
power_source_notes: Sydney West 330/132kV bulk supply area (Transgrid/Endeavour); planned capacity lifted from 300MW to 350MW; 124,000 sqm technical space. Ground broken Mar 2026 with Multiplex; IDA-endorsed Mar 2026.
certifications: Uptime Tier IV (target)
description_en: NEXTDC's 350MW hyperscale campus at Horsley Park, land-banked in 2021 and finally under construction from March 2026 to serve hyperscale cloud and AI demand in Western Sydney.
description_zh: NEXTDC在Horsley Park的350 MW超大规模园区，2021年购地储备，2026年3月正式开工，面向西悉尼的超大规模云和AI需求。

name: NEXTDC S5 Sydney (Innovation Hub)
power_source_notes: Ausgrid Macquarie Park network; 16,000 sqm technical space; IDA-endorsed Mar 2026 (State Significant Development).
certifications: Uptime Tier IV (target)
description_en: An 80MW+ Tier IV colocation and 'innovation hub' planned for Macquarie Park to extend NEXTDC's North Sydney availability zone.
description_zh: NEXTDC规划在Macquarie Park建设的80 MW以上Tier IV托管及"创新中心"项目，用于扩充其悉尼北部可用区。

name: NEXTDC S6 Sydney (AI Factory)
power_source_notes: Shares Artarmon campus grid infrastructure with S3; 4,000 sqm technical space.
certifications: Uptime Tier IV (progress to certification)
description_en: Marketed as Australia's first purpose-built AI-factory data centre, a 13.5MW liquid-cooled facility beside S3 targeting GPU-dense sovereign AI workloads.
description_zh: NEXTDC定位为澳洲首个专建AI工厂的数据中心，位于S3旁，13.5 MW、采用液冷，2025年投运，面向高密度GPU和主权AI工作负载。

name: NEXTDC S7 Sydney (OpenAI AI Campus)
address: South of Honeycomb Drive / east of future Archbold Road, Eastern Creek NSW 2766
power_source_notes: Master plan of nine buildings across three blocks plus on-site substation; Sydney West bulk supply. Recycled-water cooling dropped after pipeline permit refused, switched to waterless coolant. Phase 1 targeted mid-2027; EIS under preparation, IDA-endorsed Mar 2026.
description_en: NEXTDC's ~$7bn, 612MW AI campus on a $353m Eastern Creek land parcel, positioned as OpenAI's Australian 'Stargate' anchor under a December 2025 MOU.
description_zh: NEXTDC以3.53亿澳元购入Eastern Creek地块后规划的约70亿澳元、612 MW AI园区，依托2025年12月与OpenAI签署的MOU，定位为OpenAI在澳洲的"Stargate"锁定项目。

name: STACK Infrastructure SYD01 Erskine Park
owner: STACK Infrastructure (IPI Partners / Blue Owl); site ex-ESR Logos
power_source_notes: Endeavour/Transgrid Erskine Park supply; 156 backup generators; three-storey 82,020 sqm building. SEARS Apr 2025, EIS exhibited (EDC ~$3.7bn per exhibition; initial filing cited $650m), IDA-endorsed Mar 2026.
description_en: STACK's entry into Sydney: a 450MW single-building hyperscale campus at Erskine Park, exhibited in 2025-26 and fast-tracked through the NSW IDA pipeline.
description_zh: STACK进入悉尼市场的首个项目：Erskine Park的450 MW单体超大规模园区，2025–26年公示，并纳入新州IDA加速通道。

name: Stockland / Fife Capital Kemps Creek Data Centre (90 Aldington Road)
power_source_notes: Served by planned 1GW substation for the Aldington Road industrial estate (Transgrid/Endeavour); twelve 14MW halls; direct-to-chip liquid cooling support. SEARS 2025; IDA-endorsed Mar 2026.
description_en: A ~$3.9bn, 168MW liquid-cooled data centre proposed by Stockland and Fife Capital within the Aldington Road estate in the Mamre Road precinct.
description_zh: Stockland与Fife Capital在Mamre Road片区Aldington Road产业园内提出的168 MW液冷数据中心，投资约39亿澳元，目前处于规划阶段。

name: Stockland Davis Road Wetherill Park (Project Blue Tongue)
power_source_notes: Dedicated Transgrid substation on site; two 80MW buildings (66MW IT each) plus tape vault; direct evaporative cooling with outside-air economisation. SSD exhibited 2024, IDA-endorsed Mar 2026; ITK cites 2027 target.
description_en: A 160MW two-building campus with a hyperscaler-style tape archive on Stockland's Wetherill Park logistics site, now progressed with EdgeConneX as JV partner.
description_zh: Stockland在Wetherill Park物流用地上规划的160 MW双楼园区，附带超大规模客户所需的磁带归档库，现由Stockland与EdgeConneX合资推进。

name: Stockland MPark Stage 2 Data Centre (Project A)
key_tenants: Undisclosed (MPark Stage 1 DC leased to hyperscaler)
power_source_notes: Ausgrid Macquarie Park network; 100MW+ secured per Stockland; six-storey building replacing car park; SSD approved 2026.
description_en: The second data centre at Stockland's MPark technology precinct, an approved six-storey 100MW+ building being delivered through the Stockland-EdgeConneX joint venture.
description_zh: Stockland MPark科技园区的第二座数据中心，六层、100 MW以上，已获批，由Stockland与EdgeConneX合资交付。

name: Upper Hunter Data Centre & 2GW Battery (Akaysha Energy consortium)
owner: Akaysha Energy (BlackRock) consortium; land: Malabar Resources
city_suburb: Between Denman and Muswellbrook, Upper Hunter
power_source_notes: Co-located 2,000MW battery drawing on 500kV Bayswater and Sandy Creek Road substations carrying Central-West Orana / New England REZ output; scoping report to DPHI mid-2026; 2-3 year build.
description_en: A $10bn proposal pairing a ~1GW data centre with Australia's largest (2GW) battery on mining land in the Upper Hunter, positioned to absorb renewable-zone output near Bayswater.
description_zh: Akaysha Energy牵头在Upper Hunter矿业用地上提出的100亿澳元项目，将约1 GW数据中心与澳洲最大的2 GW电池配套，就近消纳Bayswater周边可再生能源区的出力。

name: Beetaloo Digital Weddell Hyperscale Campus
power_source_notes: Up to 2GW on-site gas-fired generation fuelled by Beetaloo Basin gas; NT Government granted 12-month exclusive commitment over 185ha site (Jul 2026); Halliburton MoU on upstream; strong environmental criticism
description_en: Beetaloo Energy's proposed A$40bn, 2GW gas-powered hyperscale precinct at Weddell south of Darwin, backed by a 12-month NT Government exclusivity over 185ha and the largest data centre proposal in northern Australia.
description_zh: Beetaloo Energy拟在达尔文以南Weddell建设的2 GW燃气供电超大规模园区，投资400亿澳元；北领地政府已就185公顷用地授予12个月独家开发权，是澳洲北部规模最大的数据中心提案。

name: Energy North Project Ares (Murranji Station)
power_source_notes: Fully off-grid hybrid gas and 6,000-7,000ha solar; ~90ha of data halls; up to 4GL/yr groundwater; referred to federal environment regulator (EPBC), public comment 2026
description_en: Perth-based Energy North's 1GW off-grid hyperscale proposal on 19,150ha at Murranji Station in the NT outback, combining gas and solar generation with its own airstrip and rail link, now in federal environmental assessment.
description_zh: 珀斯企业Energy North拟在北领地内陆Murranji Station 19,150公顷土地上开发的1 GW离网超大规模项目，燃气加光伏混合供电，自建机场跑道和铁路连接，目前正接受联邦环评。

name: Inligo Darwin Cable Landing Station & Data Centre
key_tenants: Asia Connect Cable (ACC-1), Unite domestic cable, carriers
power_source_notes: Purpose-built landing station for up to four international subsea cables (ACC-1 first) plus colocation; completion targeted 2026
description_en: Inligo's purpose-built Darwin cable landing station and edge data centre near Fannie Bay, designed to terminate up to four subsea systems including the Asia Connect Cable to Singapore and the US, positioning Darwin as a northern digital gateway.
description_zh: Inligo在达尔文Fannie Bay附近在建的专用海缆登陆站兼边缘数据中心，可终接最多四条国际海缆（首条为通往新加坡和美国的Asia Connect Cable），目标将达尔文建成澳洲北部的数字门户。

name: NEXTDC D1 Darwin
key_tenants: NT Government, Vocus, Aussie Broadband, GSL Networks, NetVault
power_source_notes: Integrated with Vocus Terabit Territory fibre and the Darwin-Jakarta-Singapore Cable landing; 7MW target capacity, initial phase live Aug 2024
certifications: Target Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001
description_en: NEXTDC's A$80m D1 Darwin, opened August 2024 with NT Government and Vocus, is the Territory's first carrier-neutral colocation facility and the interconnection point for the Darwin-Jakarta-Singapore subsea cable.
description_zh: NEXTDC投资8,000万澳元的达尔文D1，2024年8月携北领地政府和Vocus开业，是北领地首座运营商中立托管设施，也是达尔文—雅加达—新加坡海缆的互联节点；规划7 MW，首期1 MW在运。

name: DigiCo Brisbane Airport Campus (BNE1/BNE2/BNE3, ex-iseek)
power_source_notes: Multi-building campus grown from iseek's 4MW Eagle Farm facility with 6MW Tier IV-rated expansion (2019); acquired by DigiCo REIT in 2024
certifications: Uptime Tier IV (BNE2 claimed), ISO 27001
description_en: The former iseek Brisbane Airport campus, now DigiCo BNE1-3, a multi-building Tier IV-rated colocation site at Eagle Farm that is one of Brisbane's larger independent facilities.
description_zh: 原iseek布里斯班机场园区，现为DigiCo BNE1–3，位于Eagle Farm，多栋楼、Tier IV级别，是布里斯班规模较大的独立托管设施之一。

name: Interactive Brisbane Eight Mile Plains
address: 19 McKechnie Drive, Eight Mile Plains QLD 4113
power_source_notes: Brisbane Technology Park colocation site
description_en: Interactive's Brisbane colocation and managed services facility in the Eight Mile Plains technology park, part of the southern Brisbane enterprise data centre cluster alongside Fujitsu and Host Networks.
description_zh: Interactive在布里斯班Eight Mile Plains科技园的托管与管理服务设施，与Fujitsu、Host Networks共同构成布里斯班南部的企业数据中心集群。

name: NEXTDC B1 Brisbane
power_source_notes: CBD interconnection site
certifications: Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001
description_en: NEXTDC's first-ever facility (2011), a 2.25MW CBD interconnection site that remains a key Brisbane carrier hub.
description_zh: NEXTDC的首座数据中心（2011年），位于布里斯班CBD，IT负载2.25 MW，至今仍是布里斯班重要的运营商互联节点。

name: NEXTDC B2 Fortitude Valley
address: 454 St Pauls Terrace, Fortitude Valley QLD 4006
power_source_notes: Dual Energex feeds; 12MW IT design
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Certified Constructed Facility, Tier IV Gold Operational Sustainability, ISO 27001
description_en: NEXTDC's Tier IV Brisbane flagship in Fortitude Valley, a 12MW carrier-dense colocation facility serving Queensland Government and enterprise cloud connectivity.
description_zh: NEXTDC在布里斯班Fortitude Valley的Tier IV旗舰，IT负载12 MW，2017年投运，运营商密度高，服务昆州政府和企业云互联需求。

name: NEXTDC GC1 Gold Coast
power_source_notes: 6MW regional edge design
certifications: Target Uptime Tier III
description_en: NEXTDC's planned 6MW Gold Coast edge facility in Southport, the first purpose-built colocation data centre for Australia's sixth-largest city.
description_zh: NEXTDC规划中的Gold Coast边缘设施，位于Southport，6 MW，将是澳洲第六大城市首座专建托管数据中心。

name: NEXTDC SC2 Sunshine Coast
power_source_notes: Adjacent to JGA-South subsea cable landing at Maroochydore; 6MW design
certifications: Target Uptime Tier III
description_en: NEXTDC's 6MW second Sunshine Coast facility under development near the Maroochydore international subsea cable landing station, complementing the 1MW SC1.
description_zh: NEXTDC在Sunshine Coast的第二座设施，位于Maroochydore国际海缆登陆站附近，规划6 MW，目前在建，与1 MW的SC1互补。

name: Polaris Data Centre Springfield
address: 11 Mary Mackenroth Lane, Springfield Central QLD 4300
power_source_notes: Purpose-built 2008 facility in Greater Springfield master-planned city; capacity not publicly disclosed
certifications: Uptime Tier III (design)
description_en: Queensland's first purpose-built commercial Tier III data centre (2008) in the Greater Springfield master-planned city, home to government and enterprise tenants and the Oper8 colocation operation.
description_zh: 昆州首座专建商业Tier III数据中心，2008年投运，位于Greater Springfield规划新城，租户包括昆州政府、企业及Oper8托管业务；容量未公开。

name: Quinbrook Supernode Brendale
key_tenants: Undisclosed hyperscalers (multi-tenant, up to four campuses)
power_source_notes: Three HV connections to adjacent Powerlink South Pine substation; up to 800MW; up to 2,000MWh co-located BESS (Supernode battery stage 1 operating); FIRB and Moreton Bay planning approvals obtained
description_en: Quinbrook's 30ha Supernode precinct next to the South Pine substation in Brendale, approved for up to four hyperscale data centres totalling 800MW alongside a multi-GWh grid battery already in operation.
description_zh: Quinbrook在Brendale South Pine变电站旁开发的30公顷Supernode园区，已获批建设最多四座超大规模数据中心、合计800 MW，配套的数GWh电网储能一期已投运。

name: Swanbank Data Centre (Northern Concept)
address: Lot 5 Six Leaf Street (formerly Patrick Street), Swanbank QLD 4306
power_source_notes: Near Powerlink Blackstone substation, a planned 200MW BESS and Swanbank E gas power station; two stages totalling ~180,000 sqm GFA; recommended for approval by Ipswich council staff
description_en: A ten-storey, two-stage hyperscale data centre proposed on 8ha in the Swanbank industrial precinct at Ipswich, next to the Blackstone substation, which would be Queensland's tallest data centre.
description_zh: 拟在Ipswich Swanbank工业区8公顷地块上建设的十层、两期超大规模数据中心，紧邻Powerlink Blackstone变电站，建成后将是昆州最高的数据中心建筑；容量未公开。

name: Zerra DC Western Downs Digital Park
owner: Consortium: Zerra DC / Australian Data Centres (85% Dexus-owned) / Macquarie Capital
power_source_notes: 540MVA substation with direct high-voltage connection into the Braemar generation precinct; battery-backed power conditioning. Initially coal- and gas-fired supply until new renewable generation is built. Air cooling with closed-loop liquid supplement, rainwater harvesting and treated wastewater reuse.
description_en: On 16 September 2026 a consortium of Zerra DC, Australian Data Centres (85% owned by Dexus) and Macquarie Capital signed lease documentation with an Australian subsidiary of Anthropic for the initial phase of the Western Downs Digital Park at 1933 Dalby-Kogan Road — Australia's largest data centre lease to date. The 725ha campus is planned as four buildings of about 36,000sqm each with a 540MVA substation and roughly A$32 billion of investment over a four-to-six-year staged build. The development application lodged with Western Downs Regional Council on 17 August 2026 is still pending, and FIRB approval and a Dexus board decision remain outstanding.
description_zh: 2026 年 9 月 16 日，Zerra DC、Australian Data Centres（Dexus 持股 85%）与 Macquarie Capital 组成的联合体，与 Anthropic 澳洲子公司签署租约文件，锁定 Western Downs Digital Park 首期算力，为澳洲迄今最大的数据中心租赁交易。园区位于 1933 Dalby-Kogan Road、占地 725 公顷，规划四栋各约 36,000 ㎡ 的机房，配 540 MVA 变电站，总投资约 319亿澳元，分期建设 4–6 年，Anthropic 目标 2027 年首次使用。开发申请已于 2026 年 8 月 17 日报 Western Downs Regional Council，仍待批；FIRB 审查与 Dexus 董事会批准亦为先决条件。初期供电依托 Braemar 一带的煤电与气电，可再生电源需后续建设，已引发政治争议。媒体对满建容量存在 1.44 GW 与 2.16 GW 两种口径。

name: Aurora Energy Precinct AI Data Centre (1414 Degrees)
address: Aurora Energy Precinct, Carriewerloo Station, north of Port Augusta SA 5700
power_source_notes: Non-binding HoA (Aug 2026): 17MW phase 1 via 33kV, 200MW anchor campus via 275kV connection, scalable to 1GW; precinct has approved 140MW/280MWh BESS and up to 900MW solar potential
description_en: A phased AI campus (17MW, then 200MW, scaling to 1GW) proposed by an undisclosed developer on 40ha of 1414 Degrees' 1,580ha Aurora Energy Precinct near Port Augusta, the former solar-thermal site, under a non-binding August 2026 agreement.
description_zh: 一家未披露的开发商拟在1414 Degrees位于Port Augusta附近的Aurora Energy Precinct（1,580公顷，原光热电站选址）内40公顷地块上分期建设AI园区，17 MW起步、再到200 MW、最终1 GW，2026年8月签署非约束性HoA。

name: DCI Adelaide ADL01/ADL02 Kidman Park
key_tenants: Australian Government, hyperscale cloud edge, enterprise
power_source_notes: ADL02 10MW facility on the Kidman Park campus; sovereign-grade
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, Uptime Tier III, ISO 27001
description_en: DCI's Adelaide campus at Kidman Park, including the 10MW ADL02 certified-strategic facility serving government and hyperscale edge demand in South Australia.
description_zh: DCI在阿德莱德Kidman Park的园区，含10 MW的ADL02 Certified Strategic主权级设施，2021年投运，服务南澳政府和超大规模云边缘需求。

name: DigiCo ADL1 Edinburgh Parks (ex-YourDC)
power_source_notes: Adjacent to RAAF Base Edinburgh defence precinct; Tier III design; 15MW campus design
certifications: Uptime Tier III Certified Design, ISO 27001, DISP
description_en: The former YourDC Edinburgh Parks Tier III facility (opened 2016, A$30m), now DigiCo ADL1, serving Adelaide's defence-industry precinct next to RAAF Base Edinburgh with a 15MW campus design.
description_zh: 原YourDC的Edinburgh Parks Tier III设施，2016年开业、投资3,000万澳元，现为DigiCo ADL1；紧邻RAAF Base Edinburgh防务产业区，园区设计容量15 MW。

name: Firmus Tailem Bend AI Factory
key_tenants: Firmus / Sustainable Metal Cloud GPU cloud, NVIDIA-partner AI workloads
power_source_notes: 600MW firm energy supply agreement with Gunvor (Jul 2026) linked to ~1.2GW new renewables and 1.5GWh BESS (12-year); plans not yet lodged; approval pathway being settled with SA Government
description_en: Firmus's flagship South Australian AI factory near Tailem Bend, underpinned by a 600MW Gunvor energy supply deal tied to 1.2GW of new renewables and 1.5GWh of batteries, and being fast-tracked as Tasmanian approvals slow.
description_zh: Firmus在南澳Tailem Bend附近规划的600 MW旗舰AI工厂，依托与Gunvor签订的600 MW供电协议（配套1.2 GW新建可再生能源和1.5 GWh储能），在塔州审批放缓之际正被加速推进。

name: IREN Bundey AI Data Centre Campus
address: Sutherlands Road & Powerline Road, Bundey SA 5320
key_tenants: AI cloud (IREN own GPU cloud and hyperscale customers)
power_source_notes: Transmission connection agreement at ElectraNet Bundey 275kV hub (Robertstown/Bundey node of Project EnergyConnect); energisation targeted 2028; closed-loop liquid cooling; development application not yet lodged
description_en: IREN's first Australian campus, an 800MW, ~A$10bn AI data centre at the Bundey transmission hub 125km north-east of Adelaide with energisation targeted for 2028, announced June 2026 amid local water-use concerns.
description_zh: IREN在澳洲的首个园区，位于阿德莱德东北125 km的Bundey输电枢纽，规划800 MW、投资约100亿澳元，目标2028年送电；2026年6月宣布后引发当地对用水问题的关注。

name: NEXTDC A1 Adelaide
power_source_notes: CBD site; 5MW IT design
certifications: Uptime Tier III Certified, ISO 27001
description_en: NEXTDC's 5MW Adelaide CBD colocation facility, the city's principal carrier-neutral interconnection point.
description_zh: NEXTDC在阿德莱德CBD的5 MW托管设施，2015年投运，是该市主要的运营商中立互联节点。

name: Firmus Project Southgate Bell Bay (Long Reach)
city_suburb: Bell Bay / Long Reach, George Town
address: Lot 1 East Tamar Highway, Long Reach TAS 7253 (former Gunns pulp mill site)
key_tenants: Firmus / Sustainable Metal Cloud GPU cloud
power_source_notes: Hydro Tasmania disclosed on 28 September 2026 that it is assessing supply for ~444MW of combined Firmus demand across Bell Bay, St Leonards and Wesley Vale, under two contracting models: Firmus contracting directly with renewable generators and Hydro firming, or Firmus contracting with Hydro which procures new generation. Firmus has sought 2MW of new renewable capacity for every 1MW of load. No decision made; assessment due to conclude end-2026. Planning consents and TasNetworks connection arrangements to be negotiated separately.
description_en: Firmus's 288MW AI factory on the former Gunns pulp mill site at Bell Bay, approved by George Town Council in August 2026 amid strong local opposition, with Firmus now appealing generator-use conditions.
description_zh: Firmus在Bell Bay原Gunns纸浆厂地块上的288 MW AI工厂，2026年8月在强烈社区反对下获George Town Council批准，公司目前正就发电机运行限制条件提起上诉。

name: Firmus Project Southgate St Leonards (Launceston)
key_tenants: Firmus / Sustainable Metal Cloud GPU cloud, NVIDIA GB300-class AI
power_source_notes: Covered by Hydro Tasmania's 28 September 2026 assessment of ~444MW of combined Firmus demand across St Leonards, Bell Bay and Wesley Vale; two contracting models under review and Firmus has sought 2MW of new renewable capacity per 1MW of load. No decision made; assessment due end-2026. TasNetworks connection to be negotiated separately.
description_en: Firmus's flagship hydro-powered AI factory at St Leonards, approved by Launceston City Council in September 2025 (A$2.1bn stage 1) and under construction, with two server halls and a 300MW second stage planned.
description_zh: Firmus在Launceston St Leonards的旗舰水电AI工厂，2025年9月获Launceston City Council批准（一期投资21亿澳元），目前在建，规划两座服务器大厅，约104 MW已获批，二期300 MW待审批。

name: Firmus Project Southgate Wesley Vale
key_tenants: Firmus / Sustainable Metal Cloud GPU cloud
power_source_notes: Covered by Hydro Tasmania's 28 September 2026 assessment of ~444MW of combined Firmus demand across Wesley Vale, St Leonards and Bell Bay; two contracting models under review and Firmus has sought 2MW of new renewable capacity per 1MW of load. No decision made; assessment due end-2026. TasNetworks connection to be negotiated separately.
description_en: The third and smallest Firmus Tasmanian site, a 52MW AI facility proposed at Wesley Vale in the north-west, with a development application lodged in 2026.
description_zh: Firmus在塔州的第三个、也是最小的站点，拟在西北部Wesley Vale建设52 MW AI设施，开发申请已于2026年递交。

name: AWS Cobblebank (Ferris Road) Data Centre
power_source_notes: 13.2ha site bought for A$60.5m (Jul 2023); 40MW facility; part of A$6.8bn AWS Melbourne Region investment
description_en: AWS's self-build 40MW data centre on 13.2ha at Cobblebank in the Melton growth corridor, expanding the AWS Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region launched in 2023.
description_zh: AWS在Melton增长走廊Cobblebank 13.2公顷地块上自建的40 MW数据中心，已获批，用于扩展2023年上线的AWS亚太（墨尔本）区域。

name: AWS Mickleham (Donnybrook Road) Data Centre
power_source_notes: Northern Melbourne self-build site; capacity not disclosed VIC ministerial permit PA2604506 (45 Donnybrook Road, Mickleham; seven data centre parcels, Buildings A-G) received 1 Jul 2026, at referral.
description_en: AWS's northern Melbourne self-build site on Donnybrook Road, Mickleham, one of several land holdings supporting the Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region's A$6.8bn build-out.
description_zh: AWS在墨尔本北部Mickleham Donnybrook Road的自建用地，是支撑亚太（墨尔本）区域68亿澳元扩建的多个地块之一；容量未公开，处于规划阶段。

name: AWS Truganina (Delivery Drive) Data Centre
power_source_notes: Western Melbourne self-build supporting the AWS Melbourne Region (launched Jan 2023)
description_en: AWS's self-built western Melbourne data centre in Truganina, part of the infrastructure behind the Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region launched in January 2023.
description_zh: AWS在墨尔本西部Truganina自建的数据中心，2023年投运，是2023年1月上线的亚太（墨尔本）区域的底层基础设施之一。

name: AirTrunk MEL1 Derrimut
power_source_notes: Diverse 66kV HV feeds; campus expanded to 185MW (2023) with further phases to 276MW+; AirTrunk 100% renewables target via PPAs
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, ISAE 3402, SCEC Zone 3
description_en: AirTrunk's first Melbourne hyperscale campus in the western Derrimut industrial precinct, live since 2017 and progressively expanded to 185MW with a 276MW+ full-build design. Anchors Melbourne's west as the state's primary hyperscale cluster.
description_zh: AirTrunk在墨尔本的首个超大规模园区，位于西部Derrimut工业区，2017年投运，已分期扩容至185 MW，满建设计276 MW以上，是墨尔本西部超大规模集群的核心资产。

name: AirTrunk MEL2 Mickleham
address: 45 Donnybrook Road, Mickleham VIC 3064 (reported; AirTrunk has not confirmed the exact address)
power_source_notes: Multi-phase build in Melbourne's north-west; first capacity targeted 2H 2027; seven parcels, 4-5 storey buildings under state-assessed planning application (Development Facilitation Program)
description_en: AirTrunk's second Melbourne campus, announced December 2025 as a 354MW, A$5bn+ multi-phase hyperscale development lifting the operator's Melbourne footprint to 630MW+. Widely reported to be the 67ha Donnybrook Road, Mickleham land bought for ~A$350m, with a planning application filed mid-2026.
description_zh: AirTrunk 2025年12月宣布的第二座墨尔本园区，规划354 MW、投资逾50亿澳元，建成后其墨尔本总容量将超过630 MW；据广泛报道选址为Mickleham Donnybrook Road约67公顷地块（购地约3.5亿澳元），规划申请2026年中提交，首期目标2027年下半年。

name: CDC Brooklyn Campus
owner: Infratil / Future Fund / CSC (CDC Data Centres)
key_tenants: Australian Government, Microsoft, AWS (reported), sovereign enterprise
power_source_notes: Brooklyn Campus One (150-155MW) and Campus Two (200MW) both operating; third building in planning; 350MW+ at completion
certifications: Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, ISO 27001, DISP
description_en: CDC's inaugural Melbourne campus in Brooklyn, officially opened March 2026 with two operating buildings (Campus One and Two) and 350MW+ capacity at completion, serving sovereign government and hyperscale tenants.
description_zh: CDC在墨尔本的首个园区，位于Brooklyn，2026年3月正式开业，Campus One和Campus Two两栋楼已投运，满建容量350 MW以上，服务主权政府和超大规模云租户。

name: CDC Laverton Campus
owner: Infratil / Future Fund / CSC (CDC Data Centres)
power_source_notes: Ground broken 17 Feb 2025; Laverton Campus One (150MW) and Campus Two (300MW) under construction; 400MW+ additional regional capacity
certifications: Target Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic
description_en: CDC's second Melbourne campus, a A$2.7bn, 400MW+ hyperscale development in Laverton North under construction since February 2025 that will lift CDC's Victorian capacity to 780MW+.
description_zh: CDC的第二座墨尔本园区，位于Laverton North，投资27亿澳元、规划400 MW以上，2025年2月动工，建成后CDC在维州的总容量将超过780 MW。

name: Centuria / Telstra Clayton Data Centre (1822 Dandenong Rd)
power_source_notes: Existing ~12MW across two buildings leased to Telstra (30-year lease); Centuria progressing approvals and power for up to 40MW expansion after Telstra partially surrenders land (mid-2027)
description_en: Monash City Council refused Centuria's proposed 38MW, A$137 million data centre at 1816-1832 Dandenong Road, Clayton on 29 September 2026, overturning the planning officers' recommendation to approve. Councillors cited the scale of electricity demand, noise and heat rejection on nearby homes, and inconsistency with Victoria's Sustainable Data Centre Action Plan released a week earlier - the building would have sat about 80m from residences against a proposed 150m separation. A separate 40MW application on the same site remains pending and depends on Telstra decommissioning its existing infrastructure around mid-2027.
description_zh: Monash City Council 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日否决 Centuria 在 1816-1832 Dandenong Road, Clayton 新建 38 MW 数据中心的申请（造价 1.37亿澳元），推翻规划官员的批准建议。否决理由集中在用电规模、噪声与排热对周边住宅的影响，以及与维州一周前发布的 Sustainable Data Centre Action Plan 不符——拟建位置距住宅约 80 m，低于新规提出的 150 m 退让要求。同一场地另有一宗 40 MW 申请仍在审，需待 Telstra 现有设施于 2027 年中前后退役。Centuria 是否就否决提请复审尚无定论。该消息目前仅见 W.Media 一家报道。

name: Clyde North Data Centre Campus (Galileo Group land)
power_source_notes: First data centre application in City of Casey; Urban Growth Zone; further information requested May 2026; objections lodged
description_en: A A$1.12bn hyperscale campus proposed on 53.6ha at Clyde North in Melbourne's south-east growth corridor, the first such application in the City of Casey and a rare pipeline project outside the western cluster.
description_zh: 拟在墨尔本东南增长走廊Clyde North 53.6公顷土地上开发的超大规模园区，投资11.2亿澳元，是City of Casey首个数据中心申请，也是西部集群之外少有的管线项目。

name: Digital Realty Deer Park Campus (MEL10/MEL11/MEL12)
power_source_notes: Three-building connected campus in Melbourne's north-west industrial belt
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC
description_en: Digital Realty's three-building connected colocation campus on Radnor Drive, Deer Park, serving enterprise and cloud interconnection in Melbourne's west.
description_zh: Digital Realty在Deer Park Radnor Drive的三栋互联托管园区，2011年投运，服务墨尔本西部的企业和云互联需求。

name: DoverDC SM1A South Morang
address: 525-535 McDonalds Road / 765 Plenty Road, South Morang VIC 3752
power_source_notes: Adjacent to AusNet South Morang Terminal Station (SMTS); permit granted Sep 2024; construction expected late 2026/early 2027, launch 2028-29
description_en: DoverDC's approved 120MW, three-storey facility beside the South Morang Terminal Station in Melbourne's north, with construction expected from late 2026 despite a 4,600-signature community petition.
description_zh: DoverDC已获批的120 MW三层设施，紧邻墨尔本北部AusNet South Morang终端站，预计2026年底动工；当地反对请愿已征集逾4,600个签名。

name: DoverDC SM1B South Morang
power_source_notes: Adjacent to South Morang Terminal Station and substation; application filed Aug 2026 with Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
description_en: A 200MW, three-storey second DoverDC facility proposed on 8.7ha next to the South Morang Terminal Station, filed August 2026 amid Whittlesea Council calls for greater oversight.
description_zh: DoverDC在South Morang终端站旁8.7公顷土地上提出的第二座设施，200 MW、三层，2026年8月递交申请，Whittlesea Council呼吁加强监管。

name: Equinix ME4 Derrimut
power_source_notes: Former Metronode facility acquired 2018; expansion phases in Melbourne's west
certifications: Uptime Tier III (Metronode heritage), ISO 27001, PCI DSS
description_en: Equinix's largest Melbourne IBX, the former Metronode Derrimut facility, providing carrier-neutral colocation in the western hyperscale corridor.
description_zh: Equinix在墨尔本最大的IBX，原为Metronode的Derrimut设施，在西部超大规模走廊提供运营商中立托管服务。

name: Goodman Truganina Data Centre Campus
power_source_notes: Three two-storey data centre buildings; plans lodged July 2026 on land acquired from ESR; capacity not disclosed
description_en: Goodman's first Melbourne data centre campus, a three-building proposal at Mount Atkinson Road in the established Truganina hyperscale corridor lodged in July 2026.
description_zh: Goodman在墨尔本的首个数据中心园区，位于Truganina成熟超大规模走廊的Mount Atkinson Road，规划三栋楼，2026年7月递交申请，容量未披露。

name: Microsoft Garden Drive Tullamarine (MEL07)
power_source_notes: Self-build Azure facility near Melbourne Airport; part of Microsoft's A$5bn Australian data centre programme
description_en: Microsoft's self-built Azure facility at Garden Drive, Tullamarine, one of several Melbourne sites under its A$5bn Australian cloud and AI infrastructure investment.
description_zh: 微软在Tullamarine Garden Drive自建的Azure设施，目前在建，是其50亿澳元澳洲云与AI基础设施投资中的墨尔本站点之一。

name: Microsoft Woods Road Truganina
power_source_notes: On-site substation via AusNet; construction Dec 2022 to mid-2025 (Kapitol Group / BESIX Watpac)
description_en: Microsoft's self-built Azure data centre on Woods Road, Truganina, constructed 2022-2025 with an on-site AusNet substation, part of the Australia Southeast region expansion.
description_zh: 微软在Truganina Woods Road自建的Azure数据中心，2022–2025年建设，配套AusNet场内变电站，属Australia Southeast区域扩容的一部分。

name: Microsoft Yarraville Campus (MEL04 / MEL05 Cawley Road)
power_source_notes: 13ha site bought for A$90m (2021); MEL04 first building (A$150m) approved, MEL05 to follow; part of Microsoft's A$5bn Australian investment
description_en: Microsoft's self-built inner-west Melbourne cloud campus on a 13ha former industrial site in Yarraville, with the first A$150m building (MEL04) approved and a second (MEL05) planned.
description_zh: 微软在墨尔本内西区Yarraville 13公顷原工业用地上自建的云园区，首栋楼MEL04（投资1.5亿澳元）已获批，MEL05随后跟进。

name: NEXTDC GE1 Geelong
power_source_notes: Regional edge site; 4.4MW design
certifications: Target Uptime Tier III
description_en: NEXTDC's 4.4MW regional edge data centre in Geelong, the first purpose-built colocation facility for the Geelong/Surf Coast region.
description_zh: NEXTDC在Geelong Corio在建的4.4 MW区域边缘数据中心，是Geelong/Surf Coast地区首座专建托管设施。

name: NEXTDC M1 Port Melbourne
key_tenants: Enterprise, government, cloud on-ramps (AWS, Azure, Google)
power_source_notes: Dual utility feeds; NEXTDC 100% renewable electricity via certificates
certifications: Uptime Tier III Design & Constructed Facility, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2
description_en: NEXTDC's original Melbourne colocation facility in the Fishermans Bend precinct, a 16MW carrier-dense interconnection hub for enterprise and cloud on-ramps.
description_zh: NEXTDC在墨尔本的首座托管设施，位于Fishermans Bend片区，2012年投运，IT负载16 MW，运营商密集，是企业和云接入的互联枢纽。

name: NEXTDC M2 Tullamarine
power_source_notes: Dedicated on-site zone substation; 120MW+ IT design capacity after multiple upsizings
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Certified Constructed Facility, Tier IV Gold Operational Sustainability, ISO 27001, PCI DSS
description_en: NEXTDC's Tier IV flagship near Melbourne Airport, upsized from 25MW to a 120MW+ design and serving hyperscale cloud availability zones alongside enterprise colocation.
description_zh: NEXTDC在墨尔本机场附近的Tier IV旗舰，设计容量由最初25 MW多次上调至120 MW以上，同时承载超大规模云可用区和企业托管业务。

name: NEXTDC M3 West Footscray
power_source_notes: Staged build-out; ~133MW of additional capacity under construction in 2026 against forward-contracted demand
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Design (target Constructed), ISO 27001, PCI DSS
description_en: NEXTDC's largest Melbourne asset, a 225MW-design hyperscale-grade colocation campus in West Footscray that opened in 2023 and is still being built out in stages against contracted demand.
description_zh: NEXTDC在墨尔本最大的资产，位于West Footscray，设计容量225 MW，2023年开业，目前按已签约需求分期建设。

name: NEXTDC M4 Port Melbourne
power_source_notes: 150MW IT design on a 26,400 sqm Fishermans Bend site; power allocation being secured VIC ministerial permit PA2504019 (127 Todd Road, Port Melbourne) approved 16 Jan 2026 under the Development Facilitation Program.
certifications: Target Uptime Tier IV, NVIDIA-certified AI Factory design
description_en: Planned 150MW inner-city AI-ready facility at Fishermans Bend, adjacent to M1, designed to Tier IV standards for hyperscale and regulated workloads.
description_zh: NEXTDC规划中的150 MW市区AI就绪设施，位于Fishermans Bend、紧邻M1，按Tier IV设计，面向超大规模云和受监管工作负载；供电容量分配正在落实。

name: STACK MEL01 Truganina
owner: Blue Owl Capital (IPI Partners) / STACK Infrastructure
power_source_notes: MEL01A and MEL01B (36MW each) complete; MEL01C and MEL01D (54MW each) under construction; A$1.3bn green financing (Jul 2025)
description_en: STACK's debut Australian campus in Truganina: four buildings totalling 180MW, with 72MW (MEL01A/B) live and MEL01C/D under construction funded by a A$1.3bn green loan.
description_zh: STACK在澳洲的首个园区，位于Truganina，四栋楼合计180 MW，其中MEL01A/B共72 MW已投运，MEL01C/D在建，由13亿澳元绿色贷款支持。

name: STACK MEL02 Truganina
owner: Blue Owl Capital (IPI Partners) / STACK Infrastructure
power_source_notes: Single 21,000 sqm building on 14-acre site; construction completion targeted late 2025 with in-service 2026
description_en: STACK's second Melbourne campus, a single-building 252MW hyperscale facility in Truganina near MEL01, scheduled to enter service during 2026.
description_zh: STACK的第二座墨尔本园区，位于Truganina、临近MEL01，为单体252 MW超大规模设施，计划2026年投入运营。

name: Stockland Brooklyn Distribution Centre Data Centre
address: Brooklyn Distribution Centre, Millers Road, Brooklyn VIC 3012
power_source_notes: Second of two Melbourne sites with ~350MW total secured power (Feb 2026); ~100MW implied after the 250MW Cherry Lane allocation (derived, not officially stated)
description_en: Stockland's second Melbourne data centre conversion site at its Brooklyn logistics estate, with roughly 100MW implied from the ~350MW of grid power secured across both Melbourne sites.
description_zh: Stockland在Brooklyn物流园的第二个墨尔本数据中心改造用地；按其在两个墨尔本站点合计锁定约350 MW电力推算，该站点约100 MW（推算值，未经官方公布）。

name: Stockland Laverton Data Centre Campus (Cherry Lane)
power_source_notes: Part of ~350MW of grid power Stockland secured across two Melbourne sites (Cherry Lane and Brooklyn Distribution Centre) announced Feb 2026; planning permit filed May 2026
description_en: Stockland's 250MW, two-building hyperscale campus proposed on a former Toll Transport site in Laverton North, its first Melbourne data centre development under the EdgeConneX partnership.
description_zh: Stockland在Laverton North原Toll Transport用地上提出的250 MW双楼超大规模园区，是其与EdgeConneX合作后在墨尔本的首个数据中心项目，规划许可2026年5月递交。

name: Vantage MEL1 Tullamarine
power_source_notes: On-campus 66kV substation; N+1; hybrid chilled water with economiser; 2026 commissioning targeted
description_en: Vantage's first Australian facility, a 64MW single-building hyperscale data centre 6km from Melbourne Airport, targeting 2026 commissioning; a second Melbourne site (MEL2) has been flagged.
description_zh: Vantage在澳洲的首个设施，位于Tullamarine、距墨尔本机场6 km，单体64 MW，目标2026年投运；公司已预告将在墨尔本开发第二个站点MEL2。

name: Victorian AI Hub (Plumpton)
address: Plumpton VIC 3335 (green wedge, west of Caroline Springs)
power_source_notes: Reported ~2,400MW gigawatt-scale AI campus on ~350ha of assembled green-wedge land; subject to parliamentary petition seeking full assessment (closes Nov 2026)
description_en: A reported gigawatt-scale (~2.4GW) AI data centre hub proposed on ~350ha of green-wedge land at Plumpton in Melbourne's west, currently the largest single item in Victoria's pipeline and the subject of a Victorian Parliament petition.
description_zh: 据报道拟在墨尔本西部Plumpton约350公顷绿楔用地上开发的吉瓦级（约2.4 GW）AI数据中心枢纽，是维州管线中规模最大的单一项目，目前有维州议会请愿要求进行全面评估。

name: Zerra DC Melbourne Campus (former Ford Broadmeadows plant)
power_source_notes: Six-building AI and cloud campus; planning permit filed April 2026; EPA has raised objections; strong local opposition
description_en: Singapore-based Zerra DC's first Australian project: a six-building AI and cloud campus on the 45-acre former Ford Falcon assembly plant in Campbellfield, filed April 2026 and facing EPA and community objections.
description_zh: 新加坡Zerra DC在澳洲的首个项目：在Campbellfield约45英亩原Ford Falcon装配厂用地上建设六栋楼的AI与云园区，2026年4月递交规划申请，面临EPA和社区反对。

name: CDC Maddington Campus
owner: Infratil / Future Fund / CSC (CDC Data Centres)
power_source_notes: Four-building campus (DC1-DC4) to 200MW; stage one A$415m targeted operational 2026; closed-loop zero-water primary cooling; liquid-cooling ready
certifications: Target Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic, DISP
description_en: CDC's first Western Australian campus, a 200MW four-building AI and sovereign-cloud precinct in Maddington 20km south-east of Perth, with the A$415m first stage due to open in 2026 and positioned for AUKUS-related demand.
description_zh: CDC在西澳的首个园区，位于珀斯东南20 km的Maddington，四栋楼合计200 MW，面向AI和主权云；首期投资4.15亿澳元，计划2026年投运，并瞄准AUKUS相关需求。

name: DC Alliance PIER Canning Vale
power_source_notes: Independent Perth colocation facility; ~6-8MW
certifications: Uptime Tier III (design)
description_en: DC Alliance's PIER facility in Canning Vale, one of the larger independent colocation sites in southern Perth at around 6-8MW.
description_zh: DC Alliance在珀斯南部Canning Vale的PIER设施，约6–8 MW，是当地规模较大的独立托管站点之一。

name: Equinix PE2/PE3 Shenton Park
key_tenants: Carriers, cloud, enterprise, subsea cable operators (INDIGO West landing)
power_source_notes: PE3 (A$76m, opened Dec 2021) adjoins PE2; key interconnection point for INDIGO and other Perth subsea systems
certifications: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC
description_en: Equinix's Shenton Park campus (PE2 and the A$76m PE3 opened in 2021), Perth's densest interconnection hub and the landing point ecosystem for Indian Ocean subsea cables.
description_zh: Equinix在Shenton Park的园区（PE2及2021年开业、投资7,600万澳元的PE3），是珀斯互联密度最高的枢纽，也是印度洋海缆登陆的核心生态节点。

name: NEXTDC P1 Malaga
power_source_notes: Dual Western Power feeds; 10MW+ IT design
certifications: Uptime Tier III Certified, ISO 27001, PCI DSS
description_en: NEXTDC's first Perth facility in the Malaga industrial area, a 10MW+ Tier III colocation site serving the resources sector and enterprise.
description_zh: NEXTDC在珀斯的首座设施，位于Malaga工业区，2014年投运，10 MW以上、Tier III，服务资源行业和企业客户。

name: NEXTDC P2 Perth CBD
power_source_notes: 20MW+ IT design; Tier IV
certifications: Uptime Tier IV Certified Constructed Facility, ISO 27001
description_en: NEXTDC's Tier IV Perth CBD facility with 20MW+ design capacity, the city's main cloud on-ramp and interconnection hub.
description_zh: NEXTDC在珀斯CBD的Tier IV设施，2020年投运，设计容量20 MW以上，是珀斯主要的云接入和互联枢纽。

name: Project Meridien (Gingerah Energy Hub AI Data Centre)
owner: Gingerah Energy (Karajarri Traditional Lands Association / Fugro / Longreach Capital JV)
address: Karajarri country, south of Broome, Kimberley WA
power_source_notes: Off-grid: on-site wind, solar, batteries and gas; initial ~240MW IT phase then up to 1GW; closed-loop cooling; EPA referral pending; construction from late 2029, opening ~2032
description_en: A gigawatt-scale renewable-powered AI factory proposed on Karajarri country south of Broome by Gingerah Energy (Traditional Owners, Fugro and Longreach), with a ~240MW first phase targeted for 2032.
description_zh: Gingerah Energy（Karajarri传统土地所有者、Fugro与Longreach合资）拟在Broome以南Karajarri土地上建设的吉瓦级可再生能源AI工厂，首期约240 MW，目标2032年投运。

name: STACK Perth Campus (PER01/PER02) Wangara
owner: Blue Owl Capital (IPI Partners) / STACK Infrastructure
power_source_notes: PER01 (8MW, ex-DC Two/Hyperscale) operating; PER02 (16MW) expansion; 24MW campus total
certifications: Uptime Tier III
description_en: STACK's Perth campus in Wangara, built around the former DC Two facility, with 8MW live (PER01) and a 16MW PER02 expansion for a 24MW total.
description_zh: STACK在珀斯北部Wangara的园区，以原DC Two设施为基础，PER01已运营8 MW，PER02扩建16 MW，园区合计24 MW。

name: CDC Ashfords Road Campus, Gregadoo (Wagga Wagga)
owner: CDC Data Centres (Infratil / Commonwealth Superannuation Corp backed)
power_source_notes: Two on-site substations proposed; site is 1.3km from Transgrid's new Wagga Wagga Terminal Station. 384 standby diesel generators and 13MW of rooftop solar proposed. Grid capacity still to be established; land requires rezoning from rural.
description_en: CDC Data Centres lodged a SEARs application (SSD-144289240) on 21 September 2026 for a campus of up to 1.4GW on 103.4 hectares at 216 Ashfords Road, Gregadoo, about 11km south of Wagga Wagga, with capex of up to A$15 billion. Four single-storey buildings totalling 189,325sqm would be delivered at roughly 240MW each, with the pipeline running to 2034.
description_zh: CDC Data Centres 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日就 216 Ashfords Road, Gregadoo 递交 SEARs 申请（SSD-144289240），用地 103.4 公顷，位于 Wagga Wagga 以南约 11 km，满建容量 1.4 GW，资本开支最高 150亿澳元。四栋单层厂房合计 189,325 ㎡，单栋约 240 MW，分期落地至 2034 年。场地距 Transgrid 新建的 Wagga Wagga Terminal Station 仅 1.3 km，自建两座变电站，配 384 台柴发与 13 MW 屋顶光伏；用地目前仍为 rural 分区，需先行调整规划，电网容量亦待落实。

name: HyperDC Moorabool Campus (715 Ballan Road)
power_source_notes: Site adjoins AusNet's Moorabool Terminal Station and sits beside the 300MW Victorian Big Battery; grid connection is the stated rationale for the location. No PPA or connection agreement disclosed.
description_en: HyperDC filed a planning permit application with the Victorian government on 29 September 2026 for a 400MW IT load campus on 39 hectares at 715 Ballan Road, Moorabool, about 75km west of Melbourne. Little is publicly known about the proponent; the site's appeal is its position next to AusNet's Moorabool Terminal Station and the Victorian Big Battery.
description_zh: HyperDC 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日向维州递交规划许可申请，拟在墨尔本以西约 75 km 的 715 Ballan Road, Moorabool 开发 39 公顷园区，IT负载 400 MW。场地紧邻 AusNet 的 Moorabool Terminal Station 与 300 MW 的 Victorian Big Battery，并网条件是选址的核心理由。开发商背景公开信息有限，资本开支、冷却方案与租户均未披露；申请递交时点正值维州 Sustainable Data Centre Action Plan 收紧新规，审批路径存在不确定性。

name: CDC Beard 2 (BE2)
owner: CDC Data Centres (Infratil / Commonwealth Superannuation Corp backed)
power_source_notes: Up to 20MW of emergency on-site generation; a future 3,830sqm substation is included in the approved scheme. Conditions cover water use and energy monitoring.
description_en: The ACT Territory Planning Authority granted conditional development approval on 30 September 2026 for CDC's Beard 2, an 84MW three-storey facility with 12 data halls and 29,924sqm GFA at 23 Tantalum Street, Beard, costing A$203.5 million. It is the second stage of the Beard campus alongside the 39MW Beard 1; a construction start has not been confirmed.
description_zh: ACT Territory Planning Authority 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日对 CDC 的 Beard 2 发出附条件批复：三层建筑、12 个机房、建筑面积 29,924 ㎡、占地面积 10,357 ㎡，IT负载 84 MW，造价 2.035亿澳元，地址 23 Tantalum Street, Beard（Block 25 Section 11）。该栋为 Beard 园区二期，与 10 个机房、15,348 ㎡ 的 Beard 1 同场，建成后园区建筑面积约 45,272 ㎡。方案含最高 20 MW 应急发电及后续 3,830 ㎡ 变电站，批复条件涵盖污染治理、噪声控制与用水监测；开工时间尚未确认。

name: Stockland Road 1 Data Centre, Macquarie Park (1-5 Khartoum Road)
power_source_notes: 49MW maximum electrical demand against 34.3MW IT load. Consent caps standby generator operation at 55.4 hours a year excluding emergencies, and requires renewable offsets for operational emissions.
certifications: Design targets: PUE 1.35, five-star NABERS
description_en: NSW DPHI determined SSD-80814238 on 1 October 2026, approving Stockland's 10-storey (72.8m) 'Road 1' data centre at 1-5 Khartoum Road, Macquarie Park: 34.3MW IT load across eight data halls, 49MW maximum demand and A$630.4 million capex. It is a separate building from the 76.4MW Stockland data centre approved immediately to the north-west in March 2026.
description_zh: NSW DPHI 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日核准 SSD-80814238：Stockland 可在 1-5 Khartoum Road, Macquarie Park 建设十层、最高 72.8 m 的 Road 1 数据中心，8 个机房、IT负载 34.3 MW，最大需量 49 MW，造价 6.304亿澳元。批复设定 PUE 1.35 与 NABERS 五星目标，限定柴发年运行 55.4 小时（应急除外），并要求以可再生电力抵消运营排放。该栋与 Stockland 于 2026 年 3 月在同一地块西北侧获批的 76.4 MW 项目（SSD-63235720）为两宗独立开发。

name: SharonAI Ettamogah Site (former Visy paper mill)
address: R W Henry Drive, Ettamogah NSW 2640
power_source_notes: Not disclosed. Brownfield industrial site (former Australian Newsprint Mills / Norske Skog / Visy paper mill, closed late 2019) with legacy heavy-industrial supply.
description_en: SharonAI acquired the former Visy paper mill on R W Henry Drive at Ettamogah, north of Albury, for about A$50 million in September 2026, saying it would return the brownfield site to a running operation. No capacity, power arrangement or timeline has been disclosed, and Visy remains as a warehouse and logistics tenant.
description_zh: SharonAI 于 2026 年 9 月以约 5,000万澳元买下 Albury 以北 Ettamogah 的 R W Henry Drive 旧 Visy 纸厂（前身为 Australian Newsprint Mills、Norske Skog，2019 年底停产），表示将把这块棕地重新投入运营。容量、供电方案与时间表均未披露，Visy 保留仓储物流租约。SharonAI 目前在 Equinix 悉尼与 NEXTDC 墨尔本承租算力，并于 2026 年 9 月与 GreenSquareDC 的 SYD1 签订长期合同，全球在运及在建规模 212 MW，计划到 2027 年中部署约 64,000 颗 Nvidia GPU。

name: Keppel Morwell AI Data Centre Campus (Latrobe Valley)
owner: Keppel Ltd (site held under agreement for lease from Lightwood Group)
address: Former Hazelwood power station precinct, Brodribb Road area, Morwell VIC 3840 (exact parcel not disclosed)
power_source_notes: 720MW is gross site power capacity, not IT load; IT load has not been disclosed. Keppel proposes a dedicated transmission connection to nearby terminal stations, which would let future phases bypass the local distribution network. The site sits inside the proposed Gippsland Renewable Energy Zone at one of Victoria's largest electricity nodes, next to the retired Hazelwood and operating Loy Yang generation. Land is taken progressively under an annual access fee, converting to long-term leases once customer demand is secured.
cooling: Non-potable water cooling proposed using existing Latrobe Valley water infrastructure; design not disclosed
description_en: Keppel secured site control on 16 January 2026 over a 123-hectare contiguous holding near Morwell, about 152km east of Melbourne, for a 720MW gross 'powerbank' AI campus costed in press reports at around A$10 billion. The land is held from Lightwood Group on an annual access fee with long-term leases to follow as customers are signed. Keppel cites proximity to intercity dark fibre between Melbourne, Sydney and Canberra, non-potable water for cooling, and competitively priced green power. No planning application has been lodged with Latrobe City Council; discussions with hyperscale and neocloud operators are described as pre-development.
description_zh: Keppel 于 2026 年 1 月 16 日取得 Morwell 附近 123 公顷整块用地的控制权，场地位于墨尔本以东约 152 km，规划为 720 MW 毛容量的 AI 园区，媒体口径资本开支约 100亿澳元。土地由 Lightwood Group 持有，目前按年支付进场费，锁定租户后转为长租。Keppel 看重三点：紧邻 Melbourne-Sydney-Canberra 城际暗光纤、可取用非饮用水做冷却、以及 Gippsland Renewable Energy Zone 内相对低价的绿电。场地紧靠已退役的 Hazelwood 与在运的 Loy Yang 机组，计划自建专用输电接入直连邻近 terminal station，后续分期可绕开本地配电网。720 MW 为场地毛供电能力，IT负载未披露。尚未向 Latrobe City Council 递交规划许可申请，与超大规模及 neocloud 客户仍处前期洽谈。

name: PGIM Truganina Data Centre Campus (1 Oroya Drive)
operator: Not appointed (PGIM Real Estate as developer)
owner: PGIM Real Estate Global Data Centre Fund
power_source_notes: 80MW is the first-phase figure; total campus capacity is not disclosed and expansion beyond phase one is stated to depend on power availability. No grid connection agreement has been made public. Approval is being sought through Victoria's Development Facilitation Program rather than Wyndham City Council.
description_en: PGIM Real Estate's Global Data Centre Fund bought 20.7 hectares at 1 Oroya Drive, Truganina in February 2026 for about A$165.6 million, or roughly A$8 million per hectare, 22km west of the Melbourne CBD. The first of three planned phases is 80MW at a capex of about A$1.2 billion. The site sits inside the Truganina industrial cluster that already hosts AWS, Microsoft, STACK and Goodman data centre land, and PGIM has said it is in discussions on a second Melbourne site.
description_zh: PGIM Real Estate 旗下 Global Data Centre Fund 于 2026 年 2 月以约 1.656亿澳元购入 1 Oroya Drive, Truganina 的 20.7 公顷用地，折合每公顷约 800万澳元，距墨尔本 CBD 以西 22 km。项目分三期，一期 80 MW，资本开支约 12亿澳元。场地处于 Truganina 工业带，周边已聚集 AWS、微软、STACK 与 Goodman 的数据中心用地。一期之后能否继续扩容取决于电力落实，满建容量未披露；审批走维州 Development Facilitation Program，不经 Wyndham City Council。PGIM 另称正在洽谈墨尔本第二宗场地。

name: Macquarie Data Centres Macquarie Park Campus Two (Talavera Road / M2)
address: Site between Talavera Road and the M2 Motorway, Macquarie Park NSW 2113 (34,200sqm; street number not disclosed)
type: Hyperscale / AI campus (carrier-neutral wholesale and colocation)
power_source_notes: Power for the 200MW campus is not yet secured; Macquarie points to its adjacent IC3 Super West (47MW), whose end-state power is approved and energised, as evidence of its ability to obtain Ausgrid and Transgrid capacity in Macquarie Park. Design is to use advanced air cooling in a closed loop to minimise water draw. Total development capex has not been disclosed; A$240 million is the land cost only.
cooling: Advanced air cooling, closed-loop, designed to minimise water consumption
description_en: Macquarie Technology Group exercised a A$240 million call option in July 2026 over a 34,200sqm parcel between Talavera Road and the M2 at Macquarie Park, adjacent to its existing IC2/IC3 campus, for a roughly 200MW engineering and data centre campus. Subdivision has completed and initial construction is guided to finish in late 2029. Designs remain subject to planning approval and customer requirements, and Macquarie has said it is exploring asset recycling and development partnerships to fund the build. The plan also includes a one-acre public park and a research and training tie-up with Macquarie University.
description_zh: Macquarie Technology Group 于 2026 年 7 月行使 2.4亿澳元看涨期权，取得 Macquarie Park 内 Talavera Road 与 M2 之间 34,200 ㎡ 地块，紧邻其现有 IC2／IC3 园区，规划约 200 MW 的工程与数据中心园区。土地分割已完成，首期建设指引为 2029 年底竣工。设计仍待规划审批并按客户需求调整，建设资金来源上公司提到资产回收与开发合作两条路径；2.4亿澳元仅为地价，总资本开支未披露。电力尚未落实，公司以相邻 IC3 Super West（47 MW）满容量电力已获批并通电作为可获得 Ausgrid／Transgrid 容量的佐证。园区另规划一英亩公共绿地，并与 Macquarie University 合作做研究与技术培训。

name: NEXTDC D2 Darwin
key_tenants: Google reported in NEXTDC presentations as the anchor use case via the Australia Connect / Bosun subsea cable system
power_source_notes: Darwin CBD grid supply. Positioned as a network-edge and subsea-cable gateway serving energy, resources, defence and space workloads in northern Australia. Capex not separately disclosed within NEXTDC's group programme.
certifications: Uptime Institute Tier IV design target (per NEXTDC)
description_en: D2 is NEXTDC's second Darwin facility and its first at scale in the Territory, at 6MW of AI-ready capacity against D1's 1MW over 3,000sqm. The building topped out in the week of 9 March 2026 and completion is guided to the first half of FY27.
