NEXTDC positions D2 as a cable-landing-adjacent gateway and has indicated it will support Google's Australia Connect initiative for the Bosun subsea cable system.
description_zh: D2 为 NEXTDC 在达尔文的第二座设施，也是其在北领地首个具规模的项目，AI-ready 容量 6 MW，对比 D1 的 3,000 ㎡／1 MW。主体结构于 2026 年 3 月 9 日当周封顶，交付指引为 FY27 上半年。NEXTDC 将 D2 定位为贴近海缆登陆的北部门户节点，面向能源、资源、国防与航天类负载；公司材料提到 D2 将承接 Google 的 Australia Connect 计划及 Bosun 海缆系统。设计对标 Uptime Tier IV 认证，单体资本开支未单独披露。

name: Southern Highlands Data Campus (SHDC), Moss Vale
owner: Nakar Property / Cloud Carrier (privately Australian owned); Square Energy for on-site generation
type: Off-grid liquid-cooled AI/HPC campus (powered shell, carrier-neutral)
power_source_notes: Grid-independent, 'diverse ultra-resilient' on-site generation rather than a network connection. Three separate gas approvals sit behind the campus: roughly 14MW already approved; roughly 16MW under DA 26/0352, refused by the Southern Regional Planning Panel on 29 June 2026 and under appeal in the NSW Land and Environment Court (2025/00448084); and approximately 673MW under SSD-102795459, at Prepare EIS with DPHI and reported as the third-largest gas plant proposed in Australia. SEARs for the 673MW application were issued in December 2025 without the usual agency consultation, an error DPHI acknowledged on 24 September 2026.
cooling: Native liquid cooling; rainwater harvesting with zero utility water draw and over a year of drought storage; target PUE below 1.2
certifications: Australian Government Hosting Certification Framework - Certified Strategic; DB1 built to Tier III
description_en: Cloud Carrier's 67-hectare campus at 30 Douglas Road, about 6km from Moss Vale in the NSW Southern Highlands, is one of the few Australian AI campuses designed to run entirely off-grid. The first building, DB1, is a 15MW natively liquid-cooled facility described as the first of its kind commissioned in APAC and certified under the Commonwealth Hosting Certification Framework; DB2 is flagged as next. The campus is designed for several hundred megawatts, with on-site gas generation sought in three tranches, the largest of which, at about 673MW, is a State Significant Development still only at Prepare EIS and the subject of sustained local opposition and protest.
description_zh: Cloud Carrier 位于新州 Southern Highlands、距 Moss Vale 约 6 km 的 30 Douglas Road 园区占地 67 公顷，是澳洲少数按完全离网设计的 AI 园区。首栋 DB1 为 15 MW 原生液冷设施，官方口径为 APAC 首座同类投运项目，并已取得联邦 Hosting Certification Framework 的 Certified Strategic 认证；DB2 已列入下一步。园区满建目标数百 MW，不接电网，改以自建燃气发电支撑，分三笔报批：约 14 MW 已获批；约 16 MW 的 DA 26/0352 于 2026 年 6 月 29 日被 Southern Regional Planning Panel 否决，现于新州土地与环境法院上诉（2025/00448084）；约 673 MW 的 SSD-102795459 由 DPHI 受理，仍处 Prepare EIS 阶段，媒体称其为澳洲第三大在批燃气电厂。该 SSD 的 SEARs 于 2025 年 12 月未经常规机构征询即发出，DPHI 已于 2026 年 9 月 24 日承认流程有误。项目面临持续的地方反对与集会。

name: CDC Hazelmere Campus (Perth)
owner: CDC Data Centres (Infratil / Commonwealth Superannuation Corporation backed)
power_source_notes: CDC states a 100% renewable supply commitment and a privately funded dedicated connection rather than relying on Western Power's shared network. Community engagement is under way with formal development applications still in preparation; site preparation and civils are expected within a year and operations from 2029. The same Hazelmere precinct saw GreenSquareDC's 120MW proposal withdrawn in May 2026 after 1,836 objections on generator noise grounds, so acoustic assessment is the live approval risk.
cooling: Closed-loop cooling with no ongoing water consumption; acoustic screening and low-glare facades proposed
description_en: CDC's second Western Australian campus, at Bushmead Road in Hazelmere about 15km east of the Perth CBD, is planned at 192MW and targeted to open in 2029, following its Maddington campus which is due to complete by the end of 2026. CDC has framed the Perth expansion around sovereign government, defence and AUKUS workloads. No development application had been lodged as at early October 2026; the proposal is at community engagement, and it enters a precinct where a rival 120MW application was withdrawn in May 2026 on noise grounds.
description_zh: CDC 在西澳的第二个园区，位于 Perth CBD 以东约 15 km 的 Hazelmere、Bushmead Road，规划 192 MW，投运目标 2029 年；其 Maddington 园区则计划 2026 年底前完工。CDC 将此次西澳扩张与主权政府、国防及 AUKUS 类负载挂钩。公司承诺 100% 可再生电力，并自费建设专用接入，不依赖 Western Power 共享网络；冷却采用闭式循环，无持续耗水，另规划声屏障与低眩光立面。截至 2026 年 10 月初尚未正式递交规划申请，目前处社区沟通阶段。同一片区 GreenSquareDC 的 120 MW 方案已于 2026 年 5 月因 1,836 份噪声反对意见撤回，噪声评估因此是该项目最现实的审批风险。

name: GreenSquareDC MEL1 Spotswood (44-76 Simcock Avenue)
power_source_notes: Grid supply and connection capacity not disclosed. The permit is being assessed under Victoria's Development Facilitation Program, so the Planning Minister rather than Hobsons Bay City Council is the responsible authority; this removes council refusal risk but concentrates the decision politically. Victoria's Sustainable Data Centre Action Plan of September 2026, with its 150m residential buffer and own-renewable-supply rule, applies directly to an inner-west site of this kind.
description_en: GreenSquareDC has applied for a 240MW data centre at 44-76 Simcock Avenue, Spotswood, roughly 7km west of the Melbourne CBD, under permit application PA2604553 described as 'use and development of the land for a utility installation (data centre)'. The application has been under assessment through Victoria's Development Facilitation Program since 31 July 2026, with the company targeting live status around 2027. A dedicated residents' campaign is running against the proposal, and the site's inner-urban location makes it a direct test of the buffer and renewable-supply rules Victoria proposed in September 2026.
description_zh: GreenSquareDC 就 44-76 Simcock Avenue, Spotswood 递交 240 MW 数据中心许可申请（PA2604553，事由为 utility installation 用途及开发），场地距墨尔本 CBD 以西约 7 km。申请自 2026 年 7 月 31 日起由维州 Development Facilitation Program 评估，责任机构为规划部长而非 Hobsons Bay City Council，公司目标 2027 年前后投运。电网供电与接入容量未披露。项目已出现有组织的居民反对。场地属内城区，正面撞上维州 2026 年 9 月提出的 150 m 住宅缓冲与自备可再生电力要求，是该套新规的第一批实际检验对象。

name: GreenSquareDC Hazelmere Data Centre (withdrawn)
power_source_notes: Application withdrawn on 14 May 2026, five days before the scheduled Metro Inner-South Joint Development Assessment Panel hearing. City of Swan planning staff had recommended refusal because modelled noise from standby diesel generators in an emergency scenario exceeded acceptable levels at nearby receivers. 1,836 of 1,897 submissions objected, citing noise, heat, electromagnetic energy and exhaust, with additional concerns over proximity to the Helena River Steiner School, Aboriginal heritage and a conservation wetland. No resubmission or alternative Perth site has been announced.
description_en: GreenSquareDC's 120MW, roughly A$600 million proposal on 4.5 hectares at Stirling Crescent, Hazelmere, about 15km east of Perth, was withdrawn on 14 May 2026 after attracting 1,836 objections from 1,897 submissions and a refusal recommendation from City of Swan planners over standby generator noise. The record is retained because the refusal is the clearest Australian precedent to date for acoustic assessment defeating a large data centre application, and because CDC has since proposed a 192MW campus in the same precinct.
description_zh: GreenSquareDC 位于 Perth 以东约 15 km、Hazelmere 的 Stirling Crescent 项目占地 4.5 公顷，规划 120 MW，投资约 6亿澳元，于 2026 年 5 月 14 日撤回申请，距 Metro Inner-South JDAP 听证仅五天。City of Swan 规划部门此前建议否决，理由是应急工况下备用柴发的噪声模型在邻近敏感点超标；1,897 份意见中 1,836 份反对，集中在噪声、排热、电磁与尾气，另涉及紧邻 Helena River Steiner School、原住民遗产点与一处保护湿地。公司未宣布重新申报或改址。保留该条记录有两个理由：这是迄今澳洲最清晰的一例——噪声评估直接击落大型数据中心申请——且 CDC 随后在同一片区提出 192 MW 方案。

name: Digital Realty SYD13 Redevelopment, Macquarie Park (23-25 Waterloo Road)
power_source_notes: 70MW on a 1.2-hectare inner-metropolitan site implies a dedicated high-voltage supply well beyond the existing building's draw; no Ausgrid or Transgrid connection agreement has been made public. The existing single-storey SYD13, originally built for Exodus Communications, would be demolished. Operating IT load of the existing building is not disclosed.
description_en: Digital Realty lodged a SEARs application with the NSW Department of Planning in April 2026 to demolish its existing single-storey SYD13 facility at 23-25 Waterloo Road, Macquarie Park and replace it with a 23,375sqm, eight-storey, 70MW data centre representing up to A$700 million of investment. It is one of the larger brownfield densification plays in the Macquarie Park cluster, where Goodman, Stockland, Macquarie Data Centres and ISPT are all building or proposing capacity.
description_zh: Digital Realty 于 2026 年 4 月向新州规划部门递交 SEARs 申请，拟拆除 23-25 Waterloo Road, Macquarie Park 现有单层 SYD13 设施，改建 23,375 ㎡、八层、70 MW 的数据中心，投资规模最高 7亿澳元。现有建筑原为 Exodus Communications 所建，其在运 IT负载未披露。1.2 公顷内城用地做 70 MW，意味着需要远超现状的专用高压供电，Ausgrid／Transgrid 接入协议尚未公开。该项目是 Macquarie Park 集群中规模较大的棕地加密案例，同片区 Goodman、Stockland、Macquarie Data Centres 与 ISPT 均在建或在报新增容量。

name: Keppel Gore Hill Data Centre & Keppel DC Sydney 1, Artarmon
power_source_notes: Power capacity is not disclosed by Keppel DC REIT at asset level. Keppel acquired an adjacent 3,840sqm freehold plot in August 2019 for Keppel DC Sydney 1 (KDC SY 1), a three-phase greenfield build of about 57,000 square feet GFA to Tier III equivalent specification, with phase one shell, core and initial fit-out completed in the first half of 2021.
certifications: Tier III (purpose-built four-storey facility)
description_en: Keppel's only operating Australian data centre asset is at Gore Hill Technology Park, roughly 9km north-west of the Sydney CBD: a four-storey purpose-built Tier III facility held by Keppel DC REIT, operating since 2011, with multiple carrier networks on site. Keppel added the adjacent KDC SY 1 development in 2019. The record matters to the index because it establishes Keppel as an incumbent Australian operator rather than a new entrant, ahead of its 720MW Morwell campus.
description_zh: Keppel 在澳洲唯一在运的数据中心资产位于悉尼 CBD 西北约 9 km 的 Gore Hill Technology Park，为 Keppel DC REIT 持有的四层定制 Tier III 设施，2011 年起运营，场内接入多家运营商网络。2019 年 8 月 Keppel 另购入相邻 3,840 ㎡ 永久产权地块开发 Keppel DC Sydney 1（KDC SY 1），分三期建设、GFA 约 57,000 平方英尺，按 Tier III 等效标准设计，一期外壳与初始装修于 2021 年上半年完成。资产层面的电力容量未披露。该条记录的意义在于确认 Keppel 是澳洲既有运营商而非新进入者，其 720 MW 的 Morwell 园区是在此基础上的扩张。

name: Equinix ME1 / ME2 Port Melbourne
power_source_notes: Equinix does not disclose IBX-level power capacity for its Melbourne sites. ME1 and ME2 sit on the same Lorimer Street holding and are physically bridged, so they function as one interconnection campus. Equinix also operates ME4 at Derrimut, recorded separately in this index, and ME5 in Melbourne.
description_en: ME1 opened in March 2015 as Equinix's first purpose-built Melbourne International Business Exchange and remains, with the adjoining ME2, the city's principal carrier-neutral interconnection point. The two buildings are adjacent on Lorimer Street in Port Melbourne and are connected, with ME2 carrying the wider interconnection fabric. The index previously recorded only ME4 Derrimut for Equinix in Victoria, which understated Equinix's position in the Melbourne peering market.
description_zh: ME1 于 2015 年 3 月投运，是 Equinix 在墨尔本首座定制 IBX；与紧邻的 ME2 共同构成本地最主要的运营商中立互联节点。两栋建筑同处 Port Melbourne 的 Lorimer Street 地块并以连廊相通，ME2 承载更完整的互联结构。Equinix 不按设施披露电力容量。此前索引在维州仅收录 Equinix ME4 Derrimut，低估了其在墨尔本 peering 市场的地位；Equinix 在墨尔本另有 ME5。

name: Australian Data Centres Mitchell (Canberra)
key_tenants: Australian Government agencies (Hosting Certification Framework Certified Strategic workloads)
power_source_notes: Power capacity not disclosed. Electrical topology is 2N with five Eurodiesel 2.25 MVA diesel-rotary UPS units, supporting rack densities to 33kW. ADC also acquired Verizon's 105 Gladstone Street, Fyshwick facility in December 2025, originally built around 2009, and has a capital works programme under way to uplift its capacity.
certifications: Australian Government Hosting Certification Framework - Certified Strategic
description_en: ADC is the main Canberra colocation operator outside CDC, Equinix, Macquarie, NEXTDC and STACK, and its Mitchell facility has been operational since 2014 on a 2N electrical design using diesel-rotary UPS, with rack densities to 33kW. ADC expanded in December 2025 by acquiring Verizon's long-running Fyshwick site, which it has integrated and certified. Its scale is modest but its Certified Strategic status makes it structurally relevant to the sovereign government hosting market the ACT cluster exists to serve.
description_zh: 在 CDC、Equinix、Macquarie、NEXTDC 与 STACK 之外，ADC 是堪培拉主要的托管运营商。其 Mitchell 设施 2014 年投运，电气为 2N 架构，配五台 Eurodiesel 2.25 MVA 柴油旋转式 UPS，单柜功率可至 33 kW；电力容量未披露。2025 年 12 月 ADC 收购 Verizon 运营逾十五年的 Fyshwick 站点（约 2009 年建成），已完成整合并取得认证，同时启动扩容的资本工程。ADC 体量不大，但持有 Hosting Certification Framework 的 Certified Strategic 资质，对首都领地集群所服务的主权政府托管市场具有结构性意义。

name: NEXTDC SC1 Sunshine Coast
power_source_notes: Grid supply via Energex. The facility's value is interconnection rather than capacity: direct access to the Sunshine Coast international broadband cable landing station gives the shortest east-coast route into Asia, which is the rationale for the adjoining SC2 build already recorded in this index.
description_en: SC1 opened on 8 December 2021 at 44 Maud Street, Maroochydore with about 1MW of capacity, as the anchor colocation facility for the Sunshine Coast international broadband cable landing station. It is small, but it is the landing-side counterpart to NEXTDC SC2 and the only carrier-neutral facility with direct access to that cable, which gives the Sunshine Coast its only genuine claim on Asia-facing latency.
description_zh: SC1 于 2021 年 12 月 8 日在 44 Maud Street, Maroochydore 投运，容量约 1 MW，是 Sunshine Coast 国际海缆登陆站的锚定托管设施。规模虽小，但它是本索引已收录的 NEXTDC SC2 的登陆侧对应设施，也是唯一可直连该海缆的运营商中立站点，构成 Sunshine Coast 在亚洲方向时延上的全部实质优势。供电由 Energex 提供。

name: ResetData AI Factory AI-F1, Docklands
owner: ResetData, in partnership with Centuria Capital Group
power_source_notes: Retrofit inside an existing Docklands commercial building rather than a purpose-built shell, which is the point: immersion cooling lets high-density GPU racks run on a base-building electrical and mechanical envelope. Centuria has separately secured A$165 million of GPU debt and 72MW of power for its sovereign AI pipeline, of which AI-F1 is the first deployment.
cooling: Single-phase liquid immersion; no wastewater, around 45% lower emissions claimed versus conventional air cooling
description_en: AI-F1 went live on 25 August 2025 at 818 Bourke Street, Docklands as Australia's first commercial immersion-cooled AI factory, with 1.25MW of initial NVIDIA deployment inside a 1.5MW envelope, delivered with Centuria Capital Group. It is tiny by campus standards and is included because it is the reference case for retrofitting dense AI compute into existing commercial buildings, a model being pitched to Australian landlords as an alternative to greenfield capacity.
description_zh: AI-F1 于 2025 年 8 月 25 日在 818 Bourke Street, Docklands 投运，为澳洲首个商用浸没式液冷 AI 工厂，与 Centuria Capital Group 合作交付，1.5 MW 容量内首批部署 NVIDIA 设备 1.25 MW。按园区口径体量极小，收录原因在于它是在既有商业楼宇内改造高密度 AI 算力的样板：浸没冷却使高密度 GPU 机柜可在base-building 的电气与暖通条件下运行，这一模式正被推介给澳洲业主作为新建产能之外的替代路径。Centuria 另已为其主权 AI 管线锁定 1.65亿澳元 GPU 债务融资与 72 MW 电力，AI-F1 是其中首个落地项目。

name: Macquarie Data Centres IC1 Sydney CBD
power_source_notes: CBD grid supply via Ausgrid. IC1 is the legacy Sydney CBD node of the Macquarie estate, serving latency-sensitive and financial-sector racks; growth capacity sits at Macquarie Park (IC2, IC3, IC3 Super West and the planned 200MW Campus Two) rather than here.
description_en: IC1 is Macquarie Data Centres' 3MW Sydney CBD colocation facility at 477 Pitt Street, offering racks and dedicated whitespace under a 99.98% service level guarantee. It is small and operationally static, but it completes the Macquarie estate in the index alongside IC2 and IC3 at Macquarie Park, the IC4/IC5 Canberra bunker campus and the newly acquired 200MW Macquarie Park site.
description_zh: IC1 是 Macquarie Data Centres 在悉尼 CBD 的 3 MW 托管设施，位于 477 Pitt Street，提供机柜与独立白空间，SLA 为 99.98%。该站点规模小、运营上也基本稳定，增量容量集中在 Macquarie Park（IC2、IC3、IC3 Super West 及新购的 200 MW Campus Two）。收录目的是补齐索引中 Macquarie 资产组合——与 Macquarie Park 的 IC2／IC3、堪培拉 IC4／IC5 地堡园区并列。供电由 Ausgrid 经 CBD 网络提供。
